news.title: Giulia Dragoni: 'I want young Italian girls to dream of playing for Chelsea'
news.title_zh: 朱利亚·德拉戈尼：“我希望年轻的意大利女孩梦想为切尔西效力”
news.body_en: Summer signing Giulia Dragoni couldn't hold back her emotions when her shot hit the back of the net during our 6-0 win over Charlton Athletic at the weekend, and it's no wonder her eyes were filled with tears. Still only 19 and navigating a move away from her home country, the Italian midfielder has fought for minutes this season amid strong competition in her position. Sonia Bompastor has praised her strong mentality and determination to improve, explaining how the youngster continually asks for feedback on her performance. The head coach is confident more playing time will come, and Dragoni did her chances no harm by scoring her first competitive goal for Chelsea after being introduced as a second-half substitute against Charlton. Yet it was matters off the pitch that were on the agenda when we sat down to talk to her, and it appears she's settling well in her new home. 'It’s been really nice since I moved here,' she smiles. 'It's already been three months. I came here, and I didn't know what to expect from my team-mates, to be honest. Of course, I knew Keira (Walsh) and Lucy (Bronze) from Barcelona, but I was really young then; I was a little kid. Now I'm a bit different as a person and a player. 'Everyone, since the first day, has helped me a lot to adapt better to the language, to the training, to a different kind of football. They are trying to make me feel as comfortable as they can, and I'm really enjoying my time here. 'I really enjoyed our tour to Australia and New Zealand; it was a nice first few weeks. Since then, I’ve been learning every day in training and trying to take in everything that I can from the other players. My English is improving, but I think I can get better. 'Of the three languages that I can speak (Italian, Spanish and English), English is the one that I speak the worst. But I'm happy, and I'm watching a lot of series in English to learn better.' Back home in Italy, the spotlight has been on Dragoni's move to Chelsea. There, the women's game is still developing, so to see a young talent make the move to a side with multiple trophies and big ambitions has been a big deal. Dragoni is not the kind of player to let such attention go to her head, and is instead content with the thought she might be making a difference as a role model to aspiring young players back home. 'I like to think about myself as a normal, almost 20-year-old girl,' she continues. 'I'm happy that little girls from Italy are thinking about me as a kind of inspiration, you know? 'I hope that some of these little girls can now dream of being at Chelsea if they really want to one day, and if they keep working hard, nothing is impossible. But I want to keep my feet on the ground. I'm that kind of person.' The teenager is no stranger to living in big cities. Born in Milan, she earned a move to Barcelona in January 2023, before spending two seasons on loan at Roma in Italy's capital. And while she is now enjoying London, her patriotism shines through when asked to compare the UK capital with Rome. 'Rome is really nice. I think it's one of the best cities in the world, to be honest,' she says. 'Once you’ve lived there, it's really hard to compare Rome to other cities. As an Italian, I really love Rome, but I'm enjoying London so far as well, even if the weather is not the best! 'I'm maybe more of a country girl now. I think I’m a bit tired of too many people. We have nice parks and areas where we can walk near the training ground. That's the part I'm enjoying the most: being a bit calmer and having time on my own for a bit.' Saturday's match with Everton at Stamford Bridge coincides with Dragoni's 20th birthday, and she shares her special day with Alyssa Thompson, who will turn 22 on 7 November. The Italian is looking forward to the celebrations for one particular reason. She said: 'It’s good, because I don't want to have all the attention on me, so we can share it!'
news.body_zh: 周末我们6-0战胜查尔顿队的比赛中，夏季签约球员朱莉娅·德拉戈尼的射门击中球网后，她无法抑制自己的情绪，难怪她的眼里充满了泪水。这位意大利中场球员年仅 19 岁，正在远离祖国，本赛季在位置上的激烈竞争中，她已经争取了上场时间。索尼娅·邦帕斯特赞扬了她坚强的心态和不断进步的决心，并解释了这位年轻人如何不断寻求有关她表现的反馈。主教练相信会有更多的上场时间，德拉格尼在对阵查尔顿的下半场替补出场后打进了她在切尔西的第一个正式进球，这也没有伤害到她的机会。然而，当我们坐下来与她交谈时，球场外的事情才被提上议程，看来她在新家安顿得很好。 “自从我搬到这里以来，情况真的很好，”她微笑着说。 ‘已经三个月了。我来到这里，说实话，我不知道对我的队友有什么期望。当然，我认识来自巴塞罗那的凯拉（沃尔什）和露西（青铜），但那时我真的很年轻；我还是个小孩子。现在我作为一个人和一个球员有点不同。 “从第一天起，每个人都帮助我更好地适应语言、训练和不同类型的足球。他们尽力让我感到舒适，我真的很享受在这里的时光。 “我真的很喜欢我们的澳大利亚和新西兰之旅；最初的几周过得很愉快。从那时起，我每天都在训练中学习，并努力从其他球员那里吸取一切。我的英语正在进步，但我想我可以变得更好。 “在我会说的三种语言（意大利语、西班牙语和英语）中，英语是我说得最差的一种。但我很高兴，而且我正在观看很多英语系列节目，以便学得更好。”回到意大利家乡，人们关注的焦点一直是德拉格尼转会切尔西。在那里，女子比赛仍在发展中，因此看到一位年轻天才转会到一支拥有多个奖杯和雄心勃勃的球队是一件大事。德拉格尼不是那种让这种关注冲昏头脑的球员，相反，她对自己可能成为家乡有抱负的年轻球员的榜样而感到满意。 “我喜欢把自己想象成一个正常的、快 20 岁的女孩，”她继续说道。 “我很高兴来自意大利的小女孩认为我是一种灵感，你知道吗？ “我希望这些小女孩中的一些现在能够梦想进入切尔西，如果她们真的想有一天，并且如果她们继续努力，没有什么是不可能的。但我想脚踏实地。我就是这样的人。这个少年对大城市的生活并不陌生。她出生于米兰，于 2023 年 1 月转会至巴塞罗那，然后在意大利首都罗马租借了两个赛季。虽然她现在很享受伦敦，但当被问及将英国首都与罗马进行比较时，她的爱国主义表现得淋漓尽致。 “罗马真的很好。说实话，我认为这是世界上最好的城市之一，”她说。 “一旦你住在那里，就很难将罗马与其他城市进行比较。作为一个意大利人，我真的很喜欢罗马，但到目前为止我也很喜欢伦敦，即使天气不是最好的！ “我现在可能更像一个乡下姑娘了。我想我有点厌倦了太多的人。我们在训练场附近有漂亮的公园和可以散步的区域。这是我最喜欢的部分：稍微平静一点，有一点属于自己的时间。”周六在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的比赛恰逢德拉格尼的 20 岁生日，她与艾莉莎·汤普森 (Alyssa Thompson) 一起度过了这个特殊的日子，后者将于 11 月 7 日迎来 22 岁生日。意大利人出于一个特殊的原因期待着庆祝活动。她说：“这很好，因为我不想让所有的注意力都集中在我身上，所以我们可以分享！”

news.title: Vote for Chelsea’s October Goal of the Month!

news.body_en: There was no shortage of superb Chelsea goals scored in October, and now we want you to choose the best of the bunch. Our shortlist of nine contains goals from our men’s, Cobham Next Gen and Under-18 teams, in what is bound to be a closely contested vote. Make sure you have your say by watching the contenders above and then picking your favourite on the Chelsea Official App, which you can download here! The winner will be revealed on the Chelsea Official App soon! Grimwade whipped a stunning free-kick into the top left-hand corner, the dip and swerve on the ball too hot for the visiting keeper to handle. Henderson opened his Chelsea account a couple of minutes into his home debut in style, bending a wonderful finish into the Shed End net via the inside of the post. Joao Pedro’s first of the afternoon stemmed from good work from Pedro Neto down the right, before the Brazilian instinctively fired home a right-footed finish into the roof of the Bournemouth net. Henderson’s afternoon got even better when he bagged his second of the afternoon, curling a free-kick into the top right-hand corner with Djordje Petrovic helpless to stop it. Strong hold-up play from Morgan Rogers allowed Jorrel Hato to dart down the left flank, beating his man before finding Neto in the middle, who stroked his finish into the net to give us the lead at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Pennie darted from inside his own half, evading one sliding challenge before running in on goal and calmly finishing on his right. Grimwade’s second nomination is for an almost carbon copy of his first: a postage-stamp free-kick perfectly placed against Ipswich at Cobham. Greenwood equalised in the first leg of our UEFA Youth League second round tie with a powerful 18-yard strike that flew into the net after he had cut inside and created space for a shot. A brilliant recovery and pass from Romeo Lavia freed Rogers, who needed no second invitation to drive at the Man United backline. With space opening up, Rogers dribbled through the heart of the visitors’ defence before dinking the ball into the net to put us 1-0 up. Vote for your favourite on the Chelsea Official App!

news.title: Cole Palmer and the four other fastest Blues to 50 Premier League goals
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer）和其他四位最快打入 50 个英超进球的蓝军球员
news.body_en: The penalty Cole Palmer converted against Manchester United was his 50th Premier League goal for Chelsea. It is a landmark the Blues' No.10 has quickly reached. The 24-year-old is the third-quickest player in Blues history to reach a half-century of goals in the Premier League era. Palmer has needed just 105 games to do it, with his spot-kick on Saturday his third league goal of the campaign. We list below our top five fastest players to 50 Premier League goals, with Palmer in esteemed company among some of the best attackers in our history. Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink hit the ground running at Stamford Bridge after arriving from Atletico Madrid for a club-record fee. The Dutch striker brought up his 50th Premier League goal in just 84 Blues appearances, with 23 alone in his debut season when he won the Golden Boot award. Diego Costa was the focal point of two Premier League title wins, in 2015 and 2017. The Spanish international reached the 50-goal mark for us in 85 matches, midway through his third and final campaign as a Blue, when he again finished as our top scorer. Palmer’s ratio of almost a goal every other game in the Premier League for the Blues is a phenomenal achievement considering – unlike the other players in this list – he is not a striker. An amazing 22 goals in his maiden campaign set the tone for what was to come. Always a player for the big occasion, Didier Drogba's legendary Chelsea career included 104 Premier League goals, the first 50 of which came in 106 appearances. His goals helped fire us to the Premier League title in 2005, 2006, 2010 and 2015. Signed from Bolton Wanderers in 2000, Eidur Gudjohnsen quickly became a fan favourite with his intelligence, silky touch, and knack for spectacular goals. The Icelandic forward completed the half-century in 153 Premier League outings, playing a crucial role in our back-to-back title successes in the mid-2000s.
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默在对阵曼联的比赛中罚入点球，这是他为切尔西攻入的第 50 个英超进球。这是蓝军十号球员很快就达到的一个里程碑。这位24岁的球员是蓝军历史上英超时代半个世纪进球第三快的球员。帕尔默只用了 105 场比赛就做到了这一点，周六的点球是他本赛季的第三个联赛进球。下面我们列出了英超联赛进球速度最快的五名球员，其中帕尔默是我们历史上最好的攻击手之一。吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克 (Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink) 从马德里竞技以创俱乐部纪录的转会费加盟斯坦福桥后，便开始了自己的职业生涯。这位荷兰前锋在为蓝军出场的84场比赛中攻入了他的第50个英超进球，其中在他获得金靴奖的首个赛季中就打入了23个进球。迭戈·科斯塔是 2015 年和 2017 年两次赢得英超联赛冠军的焦点。这位西班牙国脚在 85 场比赛中为我们打进了 50 个进球，这是他作为蓝军的第三个也是最后一个赛季的中期，当时他再次成为我们的最佳射手。帕尔默在英超联赛中为蓝军几乎每隔一场比赛就有一个进球的比率是一个惊人的成就，考虑到与名单上的其他球员不同，他不是前锋。他在处子赛季就打进了惊人的 22 粒进球，为接下来的比赛定下了基调。迪迪埃·德罗巴始终是重要场合的球员，他传奇的切尔西生涯包括 104 个英超进球，其中前 50 个进球是在 106 场比赛中打进的。他的进球帮助我们在 2005 年、2006 年、2010 年和 2015 年夺得英超冠军。埃杜尔·古德约翰森于 2000 年从博尔顿队签约，凭借他的聪明才智、柔滑的触感和精彩进球的技巧，他很快成为球迷的最爱。这位冰岛前锋在半个世纪中出场 153 场英超联赛，为我们在 2000 年代中期连续夺冠发挥了至关重要的作用。

news.title: Seven standout stats from Chelsea's win over Manchester United
news.title_zh: 切尔西战胜曼联的七项出色数据
news.body_en: A dominant second-half performance from the Blues secured a 2-0 victory over Manchester United on Saturday and returned us to the Premier League's top four. And here are seven standout statistics from our win at Stamford Bridge. Cole Palmer scored his 50th Premier League goal for Chelsea on his 105th appearance. He's the third-fastest to reach that milestone for the Blues, after Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink (84 games) and Diego Costa (85 games). The Blues have netted nine goals in the opening five minutes of either half in the Premier League this season. No other team has scored more than three, while only in 2008/09 (10) and 2024/25 (11) have the Blues netted more such goals. Morgan Rogers became the first Chelsea player and just the second Premier League player to reach 10 goal involvements in all competitions this season (six goals, four assists), after Erling Haaland. Rogers’ five league goals make him our top scorer in the competition. Romeo Lavia won possession 14 times against Manchester United, the most by a Chelsea player in a Premier League game since Lewis Hall did so at Fulham in January 2023. It is also the joint-most by any player in the top flight this season, alongside Ipswich Town’s Argentine international midfielder Exequiel Palacios against Nottingham Forest. The Blues have kept two clean sheets in our last three Premier League games, one more than in our previous 28 matches in the competition. They were also Mike Penders’ first Premier League clean sheets, having played the last 15 minutes at Everton and the full 90 minutes against Manchester United, both 2-0 wins. Chelsea won a Premier League home game without conceding for the first time in 13 matches, since a 2-0 victory against Brentford in January. On Saturday, at 23 years and 89 days, we named our joint-second-youngest starting XI in a Premier League match, matching the age of the line-up that faced Newcastle United in October 2024. The 23 years and 21 days of the team that beat Crystal Palace 2-1 in December 2023 remains our youngest of all time in the Premier League.
news.body_zh: 周六，蓝军凭借下半场的统治性表现以 2-0 战胜曼联，重返英超前四。以下是我们在斯坦福桥获胜的七项出色统计数据。科尔·帕尔默在代表切尔西出场的第 105 场比赛中攻入了他的第 50 粒英超进球。他是蓝军达到这一里程碑的第三快球员，仅次于吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克（84 场比赛）和迭戈·科斯塔（85 场比赛）。本赛季英超联赛中，蓝军在上下半场开场五分钟内就攻入了九个进球。没有其他球队进球超过 3 球，而只有 2008/09 赛季（10 球）和 2024/25 赛季（11 球）蓝军取得了更多这样的进球。摩根·罗杰斯成为首位切尔西球员，也是继埃尔林·哈兰德之后第二位在本赛季所有比赛中打入 10 粒进球（6 粒进球、4 次助攻）的英超球员。罗杰斯的五个联赛进球使他成为本次比赛的最佳射手。罗密欧·拉维亚在对阵曼联的比赛中赢得控球权 14 次，这是自刘易斯·霍尔 2023 年 1 月在富勒姆赢得控球权以来，切尔西球员在英超比赛中获得控球权最多的球员。这也是本赛季顶级联赛球员中获得控球权最多的球员，与伊普斯维奇镇队的阿根廷国脚埃克塞奎尔·帕拉西奥斯并列对阵诺丁汉森林队的比赛中。蓝军在过去三场英超比赛中保持了两场不失球，比我们之前的 28 场比赛多了一场。这也是迈克·潘德斯在英超联赛中首次零失球，他在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中打满了最后15分钟，在对阵曼联的比赛中打满了90分钟，两场比赛均以2-0获胜。切尔西自一月份2-0战胜布伦特福德以来，在13场比赛中首次取得英超主场不失球的成绩。周六，我们以 23 岁零 89 天的年龄确定了英超比赛中并列第二年轻的首发阵容，与 2024 年 10 月对阵纽卡斯尔联队的阵容年龄相匹配。2023 年 12 月以 2-1 击败水晶宫的球队的年龄为 23 岁零 21 天，仍然是我们在英超联赛中最年轻的首发阵容。

news.title: Analysis: Midfield engine and fluid forward line too much for Man United
news.title_zh: 分析：中场发动机和流畅的前锋线对曼联来说太多了
news.body_en: The Blues returned to the Premier League’s top four after overcoming Manchester United at Stamford Bridge. We dive into the post-match statistics to detail how Romeo Lavia’s starring role and our rotating attackers left our opponents beaten. After an evenly balanced first half, the Blues came flying out of the blocks in the second period - not for the first time this season - and Morgan Rogers broke the deadlock with his fifth Premier League goal of the season, making him our top scorer in the competition and the first Chelsea player to reach 10 goal involvements across all competitions. And after Manchester United were reduced to 10 men following a second booking for Lisandro Martinez for a foul on Wesley Fofana, and Cole Palmer swept in the resulting penalty for his 50th Premier League goal for the club, we were able to finish the job in relative comfort with a dominant second-half display. Lavia was voted Player of the Match by supporters on the Chelsea Official App – and it is not hard to see why. The Belgian dominated the midfield on Saturday, covering ground and stepping in with perfect timing to snuff out opposition attacks before they could gain momentum and producing counter-attacking opportunities. The clearest example of that came shortly after half-time, when he created the chance for Rogers to open the scoring. As Bryan Mbeumo tried to shield the ball in the centre-circle, Lavia overpowered him and then reacted quickly to beat Carlos Baleba to the second ball and direct it into Rogers’ feet. The midfielder was also unlucky not to get a second assist when he demonstrated his excellent reading of the game, racing out of nowhere to anticipate a Bruno Fernandes first-time pass and intercept, before sending Palmer running against the United backline. It turned defence into attack in an instant and ended with Estevao Willian firing into the roof of the net, although the goal would be chalked off for the narrowest of VAR offside calls. The Belgian’s five tackles were the most of any player on the pitch and he came away with the ball from four of them. Overall, he regained possession 14 times, not only the highest number in this match, but the most by any Chelsea player in a single fixture for over three-and-a-half years. It's also telling that 12 of those 14 recoveries came in the opposition half and two of them in the Man Utd penalty area. Lavia didn't just sit back and protect our defence; he actively hunted the ball down to win it back from positions that we could threaten our opponents with a quick turnover. Of course, taking advantage of transitions instigated by ball-winners such as Lavia is easier when you have attacking players who can ruthlessly punish opponents. Although Rogers was not far off the halfway line when he received the ball, the way he advanced with purpose towards the hesitant defenders made the goal seem almost inevitable. It was a team effort from our forward line against Manchester United, though. Pedro Neto took on the central striker’s role in Joao Pedro’s absence and did so selflessly, holding up the ball and using his movement to create space for Rogers and Estevao to exploit coming into the channels from wide, while Palmer pulled the strings between the lines. The effect was devastating, as our attack has been so often this season under Xabi Alonso. In total, the Blues managed 19 shots against Man Utd, our highest in a single Premier League match this season. Estevao led the way by providing six of those, also the joint-highest by a Chelsea player in the league this season, in addition to his two goals disallowed. Estevao, Palmer and Rogers all tied for the most chances created in the game, with three each, and also made up the leading three for passes completed in the final third. It was Palmer who topped that particular statistic, completing an impressive 19 of 25 passes in the final third, both game-high numbers. Saturday's match underlined how much Palmer and Rogers love playing against Man Utd. The ex-Manchester City academy duo both have excellent records against their old local rivals: Palmer with five goals in eight games, Rogers with three goals in five games. Further back, Josh Acheampong again showed how he has adapted to life in the Premier League this season. The Academy graduate has been a regular in Alonso’s team, featuring in all but one of our nine league games so far, and continues to produce performances that defy his age and experience. With the movement of our attackers pulling the Man Utd defenders narrow, Acheampong was able to dominate the right flank. He kept Matheus Cunha largely in check while galloping forward to add width to our attacks at the other end. Defensively, only Lavia bettered the 20-year-old’s three successful tackles and 10 ball recoveries, while in possession only Fofana had more than his 90 touches of the ball. In addition, Acheampong’s 12 completed passes in the final third were only behind the attacking trio of Estevao, Palmer and Rogers, and more than any United player apart from Bruno Fernandes. A true all-round performance from our young right-back.
news.body_zh: 蓝军在斯坦福桥击败曼联后重返英超前四。我们深入研究赛后统计数据，详细了解罗密欧·拉维亚的主角和我们的轮换攻击手如何击败对手。上半场双方势均力敌后，蓝军在下半场突围而出——这并不是本赛季第一次——摩根·罗杰斯凭借本赛季的第五个英超进球打破了僵局，使他成为我们在比赛中的最佳射手，也是第一位在所有比赛中进球数达到 10 的切尔西球员。利桑德罗·马丁内斯因对韦斯利·福法纳犯规而吃到第二张黄牌，曼联队的人数减少到 10 人，科尔·帕尔默主罚点球，打入他为俱乐部攻入的第 50 粒英超进球，之后我们凭借下半场的统治性表现，相对轻松地完成了任务。拉维亚在切尔西官方应用程序上被球迷评选为本场最佳球员——原因不难理解。比利时人在周六的中场占据了统治地位，他在完美的时机掩护并介入，在对手获得动力并创造反击机会之前扼杀了对手的进攻。最明显的例子出现在半场结束后不久，当时他为罗杰斯创造了首开纪录的机会。当布莱恩·姆博莫（Bryan Mbeumo）试图在中圈护球时，拉维亚（Lavia）制服了他，然后迅速做出反应，击败卡洛斯·巴莱巴（Carlos Baleba）拿到第二个球并将其直接传到罗杰斯的脚下。这位中场球员也很不幸地没有获得第二次助攻，因为他展示了自己对比赛的出色解读，不知从何而来，预见到布鲁诺·费尔南德斯的第一次传球和拦截，然后让帕尔默冲向曼联后防线。比赛瞬间变守为攻，最终埃斯特沃·威廉射入网顶，尽管进球因VAR越位判定而被取消。比利时人的五次铲断是场上所有球员中最多的，并且他从其中四次抢断中将球带走。总体而言，他夺回控球权 14 次，不仅是本场比赛中夺回控球权最多的球员，也是三年半以来切尔西球员单场比赛中夺回控球权最多的球员。值得注意的是，这 14 次抢救中有 12 次发生在对方半场，其中 2 次发生在曼联禁区。拉维亚不仅袖手旁观，保护我们的防守；他积极地追球，从我们可以通过快速失误威胁对手的位置夺回球权。当然，当你的进攻球员能够无情地惩罚对手时，利用拉维亚这样的控球手发起的转换会更容易。尽管罗杰斯接球时距离中线不远，但他有目的地向犹豫不决的后卫推进的方式让进球看起来几乎是不可避免的。不过，在对阵曼联的比赛中，这是我们前锋线的团队努力。若昂·佩德罗缺阵期间，佩德罗·内托担当了中锋的角色，他无私地接球，利用自己的跑动为罗杰斯和埃斯特沃创造空间，以便从边路进入通道，而帕尔默则在两条线之间拉动。其影响是毁灭性的，因为本赛季在哈维·阿隆索的带领下我们的进攻非常频繁。蓝军在对阵曼联的比赛中总共射门 19 次，这是本赛季英超单场比赛中射门次数最多的。埃斯特沃以六粒进球领先，这也是本赛季切尔西球员在联赛中并列最高的进球数，此外他还有两粒进球被判无效。埃斯特沃、帕尔默和罗杰斯均创造了本场比赛最多的机会，各有 3 个，并且在最后三分之一的传球成功率上也位列前三。帕尔默在这项统计数据上名列前茅，他在进攻三区的 25 次传球中完成了 19 次，这两项数据都是全场最高的。周六的比赛凸显了帕尔默和罗杰斯对对阵曼联的热爱。这对前曼城青训组合在对阵当地老对手时都取得了出色的战绩：帕尔默在八场比赛中打进五球，罗杰斯在五场比赛中打进三球。再往前看，乔什·阿奇姆蓬再次展示了他如何适应本赛季英超联赛的生活。这位青训毕业生一直是阿隆索球队的常客，到目前为止，除了一场联赛之外，他在我们的九场联赛中都出场了，并且继续创造出与他的年龄和经验相悖的表现。 随着我们攻击手的移动将曼联后卫拉近，阿奇姆蓬能够控制右翼。他在很大程度上控制住了马修斯·库尼亚，同时向前驰骋，为我们在另一端的进攻增加了宽度。在防守方面，只有拉维亚比这位 20 岁球员的 3 次成功铲断和 10 次接球次数更胜一筹，而在控球方面，只有福法纳的触球次数超过了他的 90 次。此外，阿奇姆蓬在进攻三区完成的12次传球仅落后于埃斯特沃、帕尔默和罗杰斯的进攻三人组，超过了除布鲁诺·费尔南德斯之外的任何曼联球员。我们年轻的右后卫真正的全面表现。

news.title: Five Chelsea stars nominated for FIFPRO Women’s World 11
news.title_zh: 五名切尔西球星入围 FIFPRO 女子世界 11 强提名
news.body_en: Aggie Beever-Jones, Lucy Bronze, Ellie Carpenter, Hannah Hampton and Katie McCabe have all been shortlisted for the 2026 FIFPRO Women’s World 11. The prestigious FIFPRO awards are the only global football accolades decided exclusively by players and this year 6,511 women’s footballers from 64 countries have voted for their team of the year, with the Chelsea quintet among the 26 finalists. The XI will be made up of one goalkeeper, three defenders, three midfielders and three strikers, plus the one remaining player with the most votes. The team will be revealed by FIFPRO on Monday 9 November at 1pm UK time, when Beever-Jones, Bronze, Carpenter, Hampton and McCabe will all be hoping to represent Chelsea on the final list. Last season, Bronze made history by being named in the XI for a record eighth time, while Hampton and our former captain Millie Bright were also included in the team of the world's best players in 2025. Congratulations and good luck, Blues!
news.body_zh: 阿吉·比弗-琼斯、露西·布朗兹、埃莉·卡彭特、汉娜·汉普顿和凯蒂·麦凯布均已入围 2026 年 FIFPRO 女子世界 11 强。这一久负盛名的 FIFPRO 奖项是唯一由球员完全决定的全球足球奖项，今年来自 64 个国家的 6,511 名女足运动员投票选出了年度最佳球队，切尔西五人组跻身其中 26 名。决赛入围者。十一人将由一名守门员、三名后卫、三名中场和三名前锋以及剩下的一名得票最多的球员组成。 FIFPRO 将于英国时间 11 月 9 日星期一下午 1 点公布球队名单，届时比弗-琼斯、布隆兹、卡彭特、汉普顿和麦凯布都希望代表切尔西进入最终名单。上赛季，铜牌创造了历史，创纪录地第八次入选首发阵容，而汉普顿和我们的前队长米莉·布莱特也入选了 2025 年世界最佳球员阵容。恭喜你，祝你好运，蓝军！

news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea Women saw off Charlton with quick-fire attack
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西女足如何通过快速进攻击败查尔顿
news.body_en: When Chelsea made the trip across London to face Charlton Athletic on Sunday, we faced a side with completely different objectives to our own. The Addicks finished third in the Women's Super League 2 last season and earned promotion to the top flight by winning a play-out against relegated Women's Super League side Leicester City as part of the league's objective to increase the WSL to 14 teams. It's been tough for Charlton so far, and they came into Sunday's match without a single point earned in seven matches this season. From a Chelsea perspective, that meant it was imperative to win, especially with us sitting neck-and-neck with Manchester City at the top of the table. Blues head coach Sonia Bompastor has an oft-used phrase when she says she likes her team to score early to 'kill off the opposition's hope'. That's exactly what we did when Nathalie Bjorn netted after three minutes, then a brace from Melvine Malard and a strike by Ellie Carpenter all came before the 20-minute mark. For a newly-promoted team with no points on the board, against an experienced Chelsea side, that was effectively game over, and second-half goals from Aggie Beever-Jones and Giulia Dragoni completed the 6-0 win. Here's a look at how a ruthless approach secured the three points... There was no holding back on Sunday, as the Blues attempted 36 shots against Charlton, our highest total in a single match in the WSL this season. Our assault on the opposition's back line made sure there was no chance for them to dig in and attempt to frustrate us with a low block, and it also allowed us to build our goal difference to plus 23, with the title race looking like it might come down to fine margins this season. Bompastor's earlier call for the team to be more clinical has been answered, as we have scored in all eight of our WSL fixtures this season. No other team has done so. Malard and Chelsea have been the perfect fit since the striker's summer move from Manchester United. The Blues No9 has already equalled her WSL tally of six managed with the Red Devils last season and is thriving up front in her new home. One of the reasons for her superb form could be that she is focusing solely on finding the back of the net. Against Charlton, she netted her brace in the space of just 10 minutes, making a game-changing contribution early on in the match. If a striker scores twice in a game, they need not contribute much else. In a show of attacking efficiency during her 50 minutes of action, Malard touched the ball 13 times, completing all five of her passes and scoring twice from three shots on goal. It is that deadly form that will strike fear into opposition defences in the weeks to come. Another summer signing who has fit like a glove is Katie McCabe. Her high standards ensure that she puts in consistently strong performances every week and she once again stood out during the win over Charlton. Creating more chances (five) than any other player on the pitch, McCabe also ranked second for crosses attempted (six), completed passes (78) and completed passes in the final third (22). Both McCabe and her right-sided counterpart Carpenter were aggressive in winning the ball back, with the Australian ranking highest for recoveries (12) and the Republic of Ireland captain following just behind her with 11. It was another unselfish performance from McCabe and her performances could well continue to improve as the weeks go by at her new club. Chelsea supporters will have been delighted to see Nathalie Bjorn lead the team out as captain at The Valley following her injury-hit season last term. The experienced defender made her first start of the campaign against Charlton and began the match in the best way possible with her early goal. It was an assured display from Bjorn as she played just over an hour in the back line before being replaced by Alyssa Thompson. Having the Sweden international back in form will be a huge boost as the fixtures continue to come thick and fast in the coming weeks.
news.body_zh: 当切尔西周日穿越伦敦迎战查尔顿竞技时，我们面对的是一支与我们目标完全不同的球队。阿迪克斯队上赛季在女足超级联赛 2 中获得第三名，并在附加赛中击败降级的女足超级联赛球队莱斯特城，从而升级到顶级联赛，这是联盟将 WSL 球队增加到 14 支球队的目标的一部分。到目前为止，查尔顿的处境很艰难，他们在本赛季的七场比赛中没有获得一分，进入周日的比赛。从切尔西的角度来看，这意味着获胜势在必行，尤其是在我们与积分榜榜首的曼城并驾齐驱的情况下。蓝军主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特有一句常用的短语，她说她希望她的球队尽早进球，以“扼杀对手的希望”。这正是我们所做的，三分钟后纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 进球，梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 梅开二度，埃莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 进球，这一切都在 20 分钟前完成。对于积分榜上没有积分的升班马来说，对阵经验丰富的切尔西队，比赛实际上已经结束，下半场阿吉·比弗-琼斯和朱利亚·德拉戈尼的进球完成了6-0的胜利。让我们看看如何用残酷的手段确保三分……周日，蓝军毫无保留地在对阵查尔顿的比赛中尝试了 36 次射门，这是我们本赛季 WSL 单场比赛的最高射门总数。我们对对手后防线的进攻确保了他们没有机会深入防守并试图用低位拦网来挫败我们，这也让我们将净胜球扩大到了+23，本赛季的冠军争夺战看起来可能会以微弱优势结束。邦帕斯托早些时候要求球队更加冷静的呼吁得到了回应，我们在本赛季 WSL 的全部八场比赛中都取得了进球。没有其他团队这样做过。自从马拉德夏季从曼联转会以来，马拉德和切尔西一直是完美的配合。这位蓝军9号球员已经追平了她上赛季在红魔执教的WSL 6场比赛的成绩，并且在她的新家中正在蓬勃发展。她状态出色的原因之一可能是她只专注于进球。在对阵查尔顿的比赛中，她在仅仅 10 分钟内就梅开二度，在比赛一开始就做出了改变比赛的贡献。如果一名前锋在一场比赛中得分两次，那么他们不需要做出太多其他贡献。马拉德在 50 分钟的比赛中展现了进攻效率，共触球 13 次，完成全部 5 次传球，并 3 次射门得分 2 次。正是这种致命的形式将在未来几周内让对手的防线感到恐惧。另一位夏季签约的球员是凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）。她的高标准确保她每周都有持续强劲的表现，并在战胜查尔顿的比赛中再次脱颖而出。麦凯布创造的机会（5次）比球场上任何其他球员都多，他在传中尝试（6次）、传球成功（78次）和最后三分之一传球成功（22次）方面也排名第二。麦凯布和她的右路对手卡彭特在夺回球权方面都表现得很积极，澳大利亚队的抢回球数排名最高（12），爱尔兰共和国队长以 11 次紧随其后。这是麦凯布的又一次无私表现，随着在新俱乐部的几周过去，她的表现很可能会继续提高。切尔西的支持者们将会很高兴看到纳塔莉·比约恩在上赛季受伤后带领球队在山谷球场担任队长。这位经验丰富的后卫在对阵查尔顿的比赛中首次首发，并以早期的进球以最好的方式开始了比赛。比约恩的表现令人放心，她在后防线上踢了一个多小时，然后就被艾莉莎·汤普森换下。随着接下来几周的比赛继续密集而快速，这位瑞典国脚恢复状态将是一个巨大的推动。

news.title: Ellie Carpenter feeling good and taking positives from Charlton win
news.title_zh: 埃莉·卡彭特感觉良好，并从查尔顿的胜利中获得积极的态度
news.body_en: With her fifth goal of the season in our 6-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at the weekend, Ellie Carpenter has already exceeded last season’s total of three. And it’s only November. The wing-back, now in her second campaign with the Blues, has played a key role in the team’s success this season, starting in all but one of our 13 matches so far. Last week, Carpenter came on at half-time against Roma in the Women’s Champions League with the scores locked at 0-0, scoring within six minutes of the restart. After the match, Sonia Bompastor explained there was some debate over whether or not her introduction was an attack-minded substitution. ‘It's funny, because I had a conversation with the technical staff,' said the head coach following the win over the Italian side. 'I made the final decision, and someone in my technical staff said: "But we need to score, and you are bringing on a defensive player"! ‘We laughed after the game because I said: "Right now she's scoring a lot of goals, so I don't know if she's more defensive or an attacking player”! It worked, so it's good. I was confident Ellie would create a lot in the second half.’ At the moment, Carpenter is covering enough ground down the right flank to be both. She scored against Charlton, but also won the most tackles (three) and made the most ball recoveries (12) of any player on the team. ‘I’m proud of the group,’ the Blues No2 said after the win at The Valley. ‘Our number one goal in this game was to get the three points and keep a clean sheet. We wanted to score, and it’s great to come and see so many different goal scorers. There are a lot of positives from Sunday that we’ll take into the next game.’ A deeper look into Carpenter’s stats shows her impact on the team this season. In the Women's Super League, the Australian has played the most minutes of any outfield Chelsea player (714), is ranked highest for big chances created (seven), has the most touches in the opposition box (56), possession won (46 times) and possession won in the final third (10). She is also second in the team for expected assists (2.79) and chances created (19). Her numbers are not only high within the Chelsea side, but also league-wide. Only Khadija Shaw and Lauren Hemp of Manchester City plus Victoria Pelova of Tottenham Hotspur have had more touches in the opposition box than Carpenter’s 56. Only Hemp has created more chances than Carpenter in the WSL. ‘It feels really good,’ the wing-back continued after the win over Charlton. 'I'm just trying to do my best on the ball in every game, so I'm really proud of that.’
news.body_zh: 周末我们以 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技队的比赛中，埃莉·卡彭特攻入了本赛季的第五个进球，她的进球数已经超过了上赛季的三个进球总数。而且现在才十一月。这位边后卫现在正在为蓝军效力第二个赛季，她在球队本赛季的成功中发挥了关键作用，到目前为止，我们在我们的 13 场比赛中只首发了一场。上周，卡彭特在女足欧冠对阵罗马的比赛中半场替补，比分锁定为0-0，在比赛重新开始后六分钟内就取得进球。赛后，索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释说，关于她的上场是否属于进攻型换人存在一些争议。 “这很有趣，因为我和技术人员进行了交谈，”主教练在战胜意大利队后说道。 “我做出了最后的决定，我的技术人员中有人说：‘但是我们需要得分，而你却派上了一名防守球员’！” “赛后我们都笑了，因为我说：“现在她进了很多球，所以我不知道她是更注重防守还是更注重进攻”！它起作用了，所以很好。我相信埃莉会在下半场创造很多机会。”目前，卡彭特在右翼覆盖了足够的空间，可以兼任这两个角色。她在对阵查尔顿的比赛中进球，同时也是全队球员中赢得最多拦截（3次）和接球最多（12次）的球员。 “我为这支球队感到自豪，”蓝军二号人物在山谷获胜后说道。 “这场比赛我们的首要目标是全取三分并保持不失球。我们想要进球，很高兴能看到这么多不同的进球者。周日的很多积极因素我们都会带入下一场比赛。”深入研究卡彭特的统计数据可以看出她本赛季对球队的影响。在女足超级联赛中，澳大利亚人是切尔西外场球员中出场时间最多的球员（714分钟），创造的绝佳机会排名最高（7次），在对方禁区触球次数最多（56次），赢得控球次数（46次）和在最后三区赢得控球次数（10次）。她的预期助攻数（2.79）和创造机会数（19）也位居队内第二。她的数据不仅在切尔西队内很高，而且在整个联盟中也很高。只有曼城的卡迪嘉·肖和劳伦·亨普以及托特纳姆热刺队的维多利亚·佩洛娃在对方禁区内的触球数比卡彭特的 56 次多。在 WSL 中，只有亨普创造的机会比卡彭特多。 “感觉真的很好，”这位边后卫在战胜查尔顿后继续说道。 “我只是在每场比赛中尽力做到最好，所以我对此感到非常自豪。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor on why every tiny detail matters for Chelsea this season
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 谈为何本赛季每个微小细节对切尔西都很重要
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor outlined her high standards at both ends of the pitch after her side recorded a 6-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at The Valley on Sunday afternoon. The Blues fired 36 shots on goal during the 90 minutes, 11 of which were on target, while we also reduced the home side to just six shots in total, with only one of theirs finding the target. We also hit the woodwork twice and held 71 per cent of the possession in a display of total dominance on Sunday afternoon. The six-goal victory returned Chelsea to the top of the Women's Super League standings, level on points with Manchester City. It is our record at both ends of the pitch which separates us from our rivals. The Blues have scored 27 times and conceded just four goals in the WSL, recording a goal difference of +23, which works out as 11 more than our rivals, who are currently on +12. For that very reason, Bompastor stressed the importance of maintaining our attacking ruthlessness throughout the campaign. 'This league is so competitive,' she said. 'Every detail is important. Right now, we are top of the table only on goal difference. We need to make sure we go into every game with the desire to score as many goals as we can as well as the desire not to concede. That's part of our mindset and mentality.' The Chelsea head coach was also delighted with the approach shown by her players from the opening whistle. 'We wanted to start the game strong in terms of the performance, the intensity, being aggressive, but also with the ball,' she explained. 'We wanted to score early in the game and make sure we were going into half-time with the advantage. I think that's what the players have done on the pitch and I'm really pleased about that.' The Blues now have five days to prepare for Saturday's WSL clash against Everton at Stamford Bridge, before a pivotal week with an away Women's Champions League fixture against Hacken on Tuesday 10 November and a blockbuster clash with Man City back at the Bridge on Saturday 14 November.
news.body_zh: 周日下午，索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 的球队在山谷球场 (The Valley) 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技队 (Charlton Athletic)，她在攻防两端展现出高标准。蓝军在 90 分钟内射门 36 次，其中 11 次射正，而我们也将主队的射门总数减少到只有 6 次，只有 1 次射正。周日下午，我们还两次击中门框，占据了 71% 的控球率，展现了绝对的统治力。六粒进球的胜利让切尔西重回女足超级联赛积分榜榜首，与曼城持平。正是我们在攻防两端的战绩将我们与对手区分开来。蓝军在WSL中进了27个球，只丢了4个球，净胜球为+23，比我们的对手多了11个，而我们的对手目前的净胜球为+12。正是出于这个原因，邦帕斯托尔强调了在整个竞选过程中保持进攻残酷性的重要性。 “这个联盟的竞争非常激烈，”她说。 “每个细节都很重要。目前，我们仅在净胜球方面位居榜首。我们需要确保我们带着尽可能多的进球欲望和不失球的欲望去参加每场比赛。这是我们心态和心态的一部分。切尔西主教练也对她的球员在开场哨声中表现出的表现感到高兴。 “我们希望在比赛开始时表现出色、强度大、侵略性强，而且控球能力也很强，”她解释道。 “我们希望在比赛早期就进球，并确保我们带着优势进入半场。我认为这就是球员们在球场上所做的，我对此感到非常高兴。”蓝军现在有五天的时间准备周六在斯坦福桥对阵埃弗顿的女足超级联赛，接下来是关键的一周，即11月10日周二客场对阵哈肯的女足冠军联赛，以及11月14日周六在斯坦福桥与曼城的重磅对决。

news.title: Chelsea Diary: Blues prepare for Sunderland trip and Everton showdown
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：蓝军备战桑德兰之旅和埃弗顿对决
news.body_en: It's another busy week at Chelsea, with Premier League and Women's Super League action to look forward to, a London derby for our young Blues and plenty of exclusive content coming your way on the Chelsea Official App and website. We continue our reflections on the weekend, including the Blues' 2-0 win over Manchester United in the Premier League and CFCW's impressive 6-0 triumph at Charlton Athletic in the Women's Super League. There is reaction, highlights and analysis on the Chelsea Official App and website as we reflect on the latest victories from our sides. Attention will then turn to another important weekend of domestic football, with the Blues preparing for trips to Sunderland and Tottenham Hotspur, while our women's team get ready to welcome Everton to Stamford Bridge. We will hear from Giulia Dragoni on Tuesday, with the Italian midfielder discussing her experiences of adapting to life in England following a summer switch from Roma. Dragoni, who netted against Charlton, will reflect on settling into new surroundings, getting to know her team-mates and adjusting to the demands of English football. There will also be the latest news from Cobham as our men's team continue their preparations for Sunday's Premier League trip to Sunderland. The decisive match of Cobham Next Gen’s opening UEFA Youth League tie arrives on Wednesday afternoon, when the Blues host Flora Tallinn at Cobham in a 1pm kick-off. Following a 2-2 draw away in Estonia last week, there is still all to play for in the second leg, and CFC+ subscribers can watch it live in our Cobham Next Gen vs Flora Tallinn Match Centre. We will also continue building towards the weekend's fixtures on Wednesday, with the latest from Cobham as Alonso and his players prepare for the challenge awaiting them at the Stadium of Light. CFCW will also be putting in the work on the training pitches ahead of Saturday's Women's Super League meeting with Everton. With Bompastor's side returning to Stamford Bridge, we will be looking ahead to the contest with the Toffees and bringing supporters the latest news from the women's camp. Our focus turns towards the weekend's Premier League action as Chelsea prepare to face Sunderland away from home. The Blues will be looking to produce another strong performance on the road, and we will have all the latest news and features ahead of Sunday's encounter. It is press conference day at Cobham, with both Xabi Alonso and Sonia Bompastor facing the media ahead of their respective weekend fixtures. Alonso will be answering questions ahead of our trip to the Stadium of Light, and will be providing the latest team news and sharing his thoughts on the challenge posed by the Black Cats. Bompastor will also be speaking to the media as our Women's team prepare to host Everton to Stamford Bridge on Saturday. You can watch both of those pre-match press conferences live on the Chelsea Official App and website, or catch up on demand later in the day. There is a double helping of Chelsea action on Saturday, beginning at Cobham, where our Under-18s welcome Charlton Athletic in the Under-18 Premier League Cup. The match kicks off at 11am, with the young Blues looking to make home advantage count as they continue their cup campaign. CFC+ subscribers can watch the game live in our Chelsea Under-18s vs Charlton Athletic Match Centre. Attention then turns to Stamford Bridge, where Chelsea host Everton in the Women's Super League. Kick-off is at 12.45pm and the match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK. Tickets are available here, while those unable to attend can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and reaction in our Chelsea Women vs Everton Match Centre. We will also have highlights and reaction from Bompastor and her players following the final whistle. We round off the week with two away fixtures, as Chelsea's men's team travel to Sunderland and Cobham Next Gen face Tottenham Hotspur in a London derby. Alonso's Blues head to the Stadium of Light for a 2pm kick-off, looking to build on last weekend's 2-0 victory over Manchester United and secure another important Premier League win. The match will be broadcast live on Sky Sports in the UK, while supporters can follow all the build-up, confirmed team news, minute-by-minute updates and live commentary in our Sunderland vs Chelsea Match Centre. We will also bring you highlights and reaction from Alonso and his players after the final whistle. There is a London derby for Cobham Next Gen, who travel to face Tottenham in the Premier League 2. The young Blues will be aiming to pick up another positive result against their capital rivals, with the game shown live for CFC+ subscribers in our Tottenham Hotspur vs Cobham Next Gen Match Centre.

news.title: Wing-back voted as your Star of the Match against Charlton!
news.title_zh: 边后卫被评选为对阵查尔顿的比赛之星！
news.body_en: Chelsea recorded an emphatic 6-0 victory against Charlton in the Women's Super League on Sunday afternoon, and Blues fans have voted for their standout performer. Sonia Bompastor's side raced to a rapid start at The Valley, scoring four times in the opening 19 minutes of the match against the Addicks, with Nathalie Bjorn and Ellie Carpenter on the scoresheet, while Melvine Malard also added a quick-fire brace to take her tally to eight for the campaign. After that initial flurry, a second-half strike from Aggie Beever-Jones and a maiden Chelsea goal for summer signing Giulia Dragoni in the 66th minute completed the 6-0 rout. It is Carpenter who has been voted as your Star of the Match on the Chelsea Official App for an excellent all-round display, earning a 51 per cent share of the vote. Coming in second place with 27 per cent of the votes was Malard, for her two-goal contribution, while Bjorn took third with 12 per cent after scoring her first goal of the season.
news.body_zh: 周日下午，切尔西在女子超级联赛中以 6-0 大胜查尔顿，蓝军球迷投票选出了表现最出色的球员。索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 的球队在山谷球场 (The Valley) 比赛中迅速开局，在对阵阿迪克斯队 (Addicks) 的比赛中，在开场 19 分钟内就连进四球，其中纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 和艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 均取得进球，而梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 也快速梅开二度，将她本赛季的进球数增加到八个。在最初的混乱之后，下半场阿吉·比弗-琼斯的进球以及夏季新援朱利亚·德拉戈尼在第 66 分钟的切尔西处女球完成了 6-0 的大胜。卡彭特凭借出色的全面表现，在切尔西官方应用程序中获得了 51% 的选票，被评选为本场比赛之星。马拉德以 27% 的得票率排名第二，她贡献了两球，而比约恩在打进本赛季的第一个进球后，以 12% 的得票率排名第三。

news.title: Alonso: Lavia deserves huge recognition for his top form
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：拉维亚的最佳状态值得高度认可
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has hailed Romeo Lavia’s outstanding performance in our 2-0 victory over Manchester United, highlighting the midfielder’s growing confidence and impressive form in recent weeks. The Belgian produced another excellent display at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, helping the Blues return to winning ways in the Premier League with a commanding second-half performance. And Alonso was full of praise for the 22-year-old, who has continued to grow in influence after overcoming the injury problems which have disrupted his Chelsea career. ‘It was a top performance. In the last three weeks, I’ve seen a Romeo in top form. He is feeling good and feeling confident,’ said Alonso. ‘His game, from a midfielder's point of view, was very complete. He has done so many good things and I’m happy for him. He deserves huge recognition.’ Lavia played an important role in our opening goal against United, winning back possession in midfield before feeding Morgan Rogers, who surged forward and chipped a cute finish over Senne Lammens. It was one of several impressive contributions from the Belgian, whose composure in possession and ability to link defence with attack caught the eye of our head coach. ‘He has done so many things right. He was always connecting the defence with the attacking players, he was able to switch the game, he has taken many right decisions, was very dynamic and competitive. ‘So I think, not just this game but in the last two or three weeks, he has been playing at a very good level and I’m very happy for him.’ Equally encouraging for Alonso was Lavia's ability to complete another 90 minutes, having also played the entirety of Wednesday's Carabao Cup encounter with Liverpool at Anfield. With Jordan Henderson unavailable through illness, the Belgian retained his place alongside Moises Caicedo and showed no signs of fatigue as the Blues took control after the interval. Alonso believes Lavia's increasing confidence has been crucial to his ability to handle the demands of consecutive matches. ‘We knew Jordan was not feeling that well and we know Rom is feeling better, is feeling stronger, is feeling more confident to go with more minutes and with more load. ‘And he’s gone from playing the whole game at Anfield, to not even 72 hours later playing that way and with that energy [against Man United]. Sometimes the head is more important than the legs and now his head is in a good place.’ It is another positive step for Lavia, whose performances are giving Alonso plenty of encouragement as the Blues look to build on Saturday's victory.
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索赞扬了罗密欧·拉维亚在我们2-0战胜曼联的比赛中的出色表现，强调了这位中场球员最近几周不断增长的信心和令人印象深刻的状态。周六，比利时人在斯坦福桥再次展现出色表现，以下半场的出色表现帮助蓝军重回英超胜利之路。阿隆索对这位22岁的球员赞不绝口，在克服了困扰他切尔西生涯的伤病问题后，他的影响力持续增长。 ‘这是一场顶级的表演。在过去的三周里，我看到了罗密欧的最佳状态。他感觉很好并且充满信心，”阿隆索说。 “从中场球员的角度来看，他的比赛非常完整。他做了很多好事，我为他感到高兴。他值得得到巨大的认可。”拉维亚在我们对阵曼联的首个进球中发挥了重要作用，在中场夺回控球权，然后传球给摩根·罗杰斯，摩根·罗杰斯向前冲锋，漂亮地射门超越了塞内·拉门斯。这是比利时人做出的几项令人印象深刻的贡献之一，他控球时的冷静以及将防守与进攻结合起来的能力引起了我们主教练的注意。 ‘他做了很多正确的事情。他总是将防守与进攻球员联系起来，他能够改变比赛，他做出了许多正确的决定，非常有活力和竞争力。 “所以我认为，不仅是这场比赛，而且在过去的两三周里，他都踢出了非常好的水平，我为他感到非常高兴。”同样令阿隆索鼓舞的是拉维亚能够再踢满90分钟，他还踢满了周三在安菲尔德对阵利物浦的卡拉宝杯比赛。由于乔丹·亨德森因病无法上场，这位比利时人保留了与莫伊塞斯·凯塞多并肩作战的位置，并且在中场休息后蓝军控制了局面，他没有表现出任何疲劳的迹象。阿隆索相信拉维亚日益增强的信心对于他处理连续比赛要求的能力至关重要。 “我们知道乔丹感觉不太好，我们知道罗姆感觉更好，感觉更强壮，更有信心在更多的上场时间和更多的负荷下继续比赛。 “他从在安菲尔德打满整场比赛，到不到 72 小时后，他仍然以那样的方式和精力（对阵曼联）。有时头部比腿部更重要，现在他的头部处于一个好的位置。这对拉维亚来说是又一个积极的一步，她的表现给了阿隆索很大的鼓励，蓝军希望在周六的胜利基础上再接再厉。

news.title: From the archive: It was always Chelsea for birthday boy Caicedo
news.title_zh: 来自档案：生日男孩凯塞多总是在切尔西
news.body_en: As Moises Caicedo celebrates his 25th birthday we republish an interview the midfielder conducted shortly after signing for Chelsea, in which he explained how his love for the Blues began a long time earlier... This article was first published in the official Chelsea matchday programme in November 2023. When Moises Caicedo was unveiled as a Chelsea player, the club’s content team recreated a photograph of him sat on the bumper of a car with his mum, Carmen, taken a few years earlier in Ecuador. Caicedo is in his late teens in the original photo – already a young professional footballer in his homeland – and he is wearing the Chelsea home shirt from the 2020/21 season. ‘It’s only ever been Chelsea,’ read the caption on the announcement post, referencing the fact that we were not the only club interested in signing the midfielder from Brighton. But what was the story behind that Blues shirt in the photo from 2020? View this post on Instagram            A post shared by Chelsea FC (@chelseafc) ‘I spoke to my old agent and I asked him if I could get that shirt,’ he told us. ‘I wanted N’Golo Kante’s shirt, but it was a bit impossible to get it. But he said, “I’m gonna buy one for you.” ‘One day, he came to Ecuador and said, “Look, I have a present for you,” and it was that shirt. It was fantastic for me, and I started to wear it. It was like a motivation for me, because Chelsea was one of the best teams I watched when I was a kid.’ Caicedo’s fascination with all-action Blues midfielders went back further than Kante, though… ‘I used to watch videos of [Claude] Makelele from when he was here,’ he added, ‘because when I started to play in midfield, I started to watch videos of Chelsea. I saw some videos of Makelele and some of Kante as well. It was a motivation for me to play football because they were legends here.’ It shows how seriously Caicedo took his development when you consider that he was six years old when Makelele departed the Bridge at the end of the 2007/08 season. He was watching archive footage of that Chelsea vintage that dominated the Premier League for two years in the mid-2000s. Caicedo has dreamed of playing at the very highest level ever since. As a kid, he played football in the streets of Santo Domingo in Ecuador, where his older brothers and their friends used to tell him he had the talent to go places. Even as he felt he was simply learning the game, they were offering him advice, saying things like: “If you want to be one of the best players in the world, you have to work hard, you have to fight, you have to train every day.” After hearing comments like these for several years, it became clear to him that he must have a chance. ‘To be honest, they saw something in me and felt I could be a top player, but I didn’t feel it because it was so hard to play against them,’ he said. ‘They were really good, but my dedication and my hard work were everything. When I was a kid, my dad used to say to me that you have to work hard to be one of the best. ‘When I played with my brother’s friends, it was good, but it was tough at the same time. They were older and stronger than me; they kept the ball, and I was frustrated when I couldn’t get the ball from them because they were too strong. 'But it was good for me, because I learned from them and they were like a motivation, an inspiration for me. They were with me in every moment when I was a kid.’ Caicedo was surrounded by family throughout his childhood. He has nine siblings, the eldest of whom have children around his age, so he was never short of team-mates for kickabouts. He could also count on the support of a local coach, Ivan Guerra, who helped to prepare him for the competitive game. Eventually, one of his brothers took him to Independiente del Valle – one of Ecuador’s top football clubs – for a trial. It was a chance for him to test his mettle against the nation’s best talents, and he made it into their ranks. ‘Independiente del Valle is a big club,’ he says of the club from Sangolqui. ‘If you go there, you’re going to find the best players in Ecuador. They are in every city in Ecuador, looking for the best players in the country. ‘It’s amazing because you have a school inside the club, you have rooms to sleep and live there, you have everything. You have good food, good facilities, and a training ground. It’s the best place to start. I learned a lot from them.’ Independiente’s academy is about a two-hour drive from Caicedo’s hometown, so it was a first taste of independence for him, while he remained very close to his family. On the pitch, he excelled at a club known for developing top young talent, and captained his age group to the Under-20 Copa Libertadores title. ‘We got a great reception in Ecuador,’ Caicedo says, thinking back to that triumph. ‘There was a “caravana” – like a really crazy party. Then they gave us a few days off to celebrate with the family.’ The following winter, Caicedo was signed by Brighton & Hove Albion, having played just over 30 first-team games for Independiente del Valle. He was already a full Ecuador international by that point, and it was clear that he had enormous potential, but he was only 19 and moving to Europe amid a global pandemic. He found himself confined to a hotel in Brighton, looking out at the choppy channel in the middle of the British winter, about 9,000 miles from his tight-knit family. These are the unseen challenges that young footballers from around the world face when they travel to Europe in search of an opportunity. ‘It was tough,’ Moi admitted. ‘It was really tough, because I came here on my own, without my family. I didn’t know English, it was a different time zone, different food… the weather is so different! It was really tough for me. ‘I came here when Covid was blowing up, and before I could go out in England, I had to stay for 10 days in a hotel. I didn’t meet my team-mates. I cried every day in that hotel. I remember calling my mum and dad and I told them I wanted to come back to Ecuador because everything was so different. I didn’t want to be here. 'They said: "Son, you have to be strong. This is your dream. You prayed for this. So keep strong, keep praying, because God is everything in our life.” ‘So, I started to do that. Every day, I kept praying and I started to feel better and better.'
news.body_zh: 在莫伊塞斯·凯塞多庆祝 25 岁生日之际，我们重新发布了这位中场球员在加盟切尔西后不久进行的一次采访，其中他解释了他对蓝军的热爱是如何在很久以前就开始的……这篇文章于 2023 年 11 月首次发表在切尔西官方比赛日节目中。当莫伊塞斯·凯塞多以切尔西球员身份亮相时，俱乐部的内容团队重新制作了一张几年前拍摄的他和妈妈卡门坐在汽车保险杠上的照片在厄瓜多尔。在原始照片中，凯塞多才十几岁，在他的祖国已经是一名年轻的职业足球运动员，他穿着 2020/21 赛季的切尔西主场球衣。 “只有切尔西，”公告上的标题写道，指的是我们并不是唯一有兴趣签下布莱顿中场球员的俱乐部。但 2020 年照片中的那件蓝调衬衫背后有什么故事呢？在 Instagram 上查看这篇文章 切尔西足球俱乐部 (@chelseafc) 分享的帖子 “我和我的前经纪人谈过，我问他是否可以得到那件球衣，”他告诉我们。 “我想要恩戈洛·坎特的球衣，但有点不可能得到。但他说：“我给你买一个。” “有一天，他来到厄瓜多尔说，‘看，我有一件礼物给你，’那就是那件衬衫。这对我来说太棒了，我开始穿它。这对我来说就像是一种动力，因为切尔西是我小时候看过的最好的球队之一。”凯塞多对全能蓝军中场球员的迷恋可以追溯到坎特之前……“我曾经看过[克劳德]马克莱莱在这里的视频，”他补充道，“因为当我开始踢中场时，我开始观看切尔西的视频。我看了一些马克莱莱和坎特的视频。这是我踢球的动力，因为他们是这里的传奇人物。”当马克莱莱在 2007/08 赛季结束离开蓝桥时，凯塞多只有六岁，这表明凯塞多对自己的发展是多么认真。他正在观看 2000 年代中期切尔西统治英超两年的档案录像。从那时起，凯塞多就梦想着能够参加最高水平的比赛。小时候，他在厄瓜多尔圣多明各的街道上踢足球，他的哥哥和他们的朋友常常告诉他，他有去往不同地方的天赋。即使他觉得自己只是在学习这项运动，他们还是给他提供了建议，比如：“如果你想成为世界上最好的球员之一，你就必须努力工作，你必须战斗，你必须每天训练。”几年来一直听到这样的评论，他清楚自己一定有机会。 “说实话，他们在我身上看到了一些东西，觉得我可以成为一名顶级球员，但我没有这种感觉，因为和他们比赛太难了，”他说。 “他们真的很棒，但我的奉献和努力就是一切。当我还是个孩子的时候，我爸爸常常对我说，你必须努力工作才能成为最好的人之一。 “当我和我哥哥的朋友们一起踢球时，感觉很好，但同时也很艰难。他们比我年长，比我强壮；他们保住了球，当我因为他们太强大而无法从他们手中拿到球时，我感到很沮丧。 “但这对我有好处，因为我向他们学习，他们对我来说就像一种动力、一种灵感。当我还是个孩子的时候，他们每时每刻都在我身边。”凯塞多的整个童年都被家人包围着。他有九个兄弟姐妹，其中最大的孩子也有与他年龄相仿的孩子，所以他从来不缺可以踢球的队友。他还可以得到当地教练伊万·格拉（Ivan Guerra）的支持，帮助他为比赛做好准备。最终，他的一个兄弟带他去了厄瓜多尔顶级足球俱乐部之一的独立德尔瓦莱队试训。这对他来说是一次与全国最优秀人才检验自己勇气的机会，他也进入了他们的行列。 “Independiente del Valle 是一家大俱乐部，”他谈到来自桑戈尔基的俱乐部时说道。 “如果你去那里，你会发现厄瓜多尔最好的球员。他们在厄瓜多尔的每个城市寻找该国最好的球员。 “这太棒了，因为俱乐部内有一所学校，你有房间睡觉和居住，你拥有一切。这里有美味的食物、良好的设施和训练场。这是最好的起点。 我从他们身上学到了很多东西。”独立学院距离凯塞多的家乡大约有两个小时的车程，所以这是他第一次尝到独立的滋味，同时他与家人仍然非常亲密。在球场上，他在一家以培养顶尖年轻人才而闻名的俱乐部中表现出色，并作为队长带领所在年龄段的球队夺得了 20 岁以下南美解放者杯冠军。 “我们在厄瓜多尔受到了热烈的欢迎，”凯塞多回忆起那次胜利说道。 “有一场‘卡拉瓦纳’——就像一场非常疯狂的派对。然后他们给了我们几天假期与家人一起庆祝。”第二年冬天，凯塞多被布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩签下，当时他为独立德尔瓦莱队踢了 30 多场一线队比赛。那时他已经是一名正式的厄瓜多尔国脚，很明显他拥有巨大的潜力，但他只有 19 岁，在全球大流行期间搬到了欧洲。在英国的隆冬，他发现自己被困在布莱顿的一家酒店里，眺望着波涛汹涌的海峡，距离他亲密的家人大约 9,000 英里。这些是世界各地的年轻足球运动员前往欧洲寻找机会时面临的看不见的挑战。 “这很艰难，”莫伊承认。 “这真的很艰难，因为我独自来到这里，没有家人。我不懂英语，不同的时区，不同的食物……天气是如此不同！这对我来说真的很难。 “我在新冠疫情爆发时来到了这里，在去英格兰之前，我必须在酒店住10天。我没有见到我的队友。我在那家旅馆里每天都哭。我记得打电话给我的妈妈和爸爸，我告诉他们我想回到厄瓜多尔，因为一切都如此不同。我不想呆在这里。 “他们说：‘孩子，你必须坚强。这是你的梦想。你为此祈祷。所以保持坚强，继续祈祷，因为上帝是我们生命中的一切。’” ‘所以，我开始这样做。每天，我都不断祈祷，我开始感觉越来越好。”

news.title: Rogers: I want to be more ruthless in front of goal
news.title_zh: 罗杰斯：我想在球门前更狠
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers is determined to become more clinical in front of goal, with the Chelsea forward keen to build on his superb solo effort in our 2-0 Premier League victory over Manchester United. The England international broke the deadlock early in the second half at Stamford Bridge, producing a brilliant individual goal to help the Blues return to winning ways. But despite having scored six goals and provided four assists in all competitions this term, Rogers believes there is still plenty of room for improvement in his attacking game. Rogers said: 'I think being more clinical in front of goal, being more ruthless in and around the box, is something that previously I was a bit disappointed in myself because I'd score a nice goal every once in a while, but I wouldn't score the easy goals. I'm trying to work on that here. 'I'm trying to improve in my final actions, so that's my biggest one. I'm an attacker, so I try to score goals and assist and create chances, and I want to keep improving. I'm not there yet, but it's a good start!' Rogers certainly demonstrated his quality for the opener, collecting Romeo Lavia's pass in midfield before driving towards the visitors' penalty area. With Estevao making a supporting run, the 24-year-old spotted an opening in the United defence, glided beyond two challenges and calmly dinked the ball over Senne Lammens. He said: 'I knew it was a counter-attacking opportunity to drive, and I think Estevao made the run on the outside. I was just going to keep driving and I was looking to play him, but then the space just kind of opened up and I just kept going. 'Then it was just about being composed in front of goal and luckily it went in.' The goal came at an important moment for the Blues, who had endured a difficult first half before taking control after the interval. Cole Palmer subsequently doubled our advantage from the penalty spot, securing a welcome victory following recent setbacks against Tottenham Hotspur and Liverpool. While Rogers was pleased with the quality of his finish, he took even greater satisfaction from helping his side secure all three points. 'It was nice to see it go in the back of the net at an important time in the game,' he added. 'So that's the most important thing for me, that I can make a difference to the game and ultimately we go on and win the game because of it, so I'm happy.' Having embraced a new challenge following two years at Aston Villa, Rogers is enjoying life at Chelsea and believes the squad will continue developing together. 'I'm loving it. It's a different challenge, a new challenge, and I'm really enjoying playing with these wonderful quality players. 'It's just about the team coming together as a whole. There are some good times, bad times, but I've just got to be a bit of a leader, stick to what I know and do the best I can. So we just need to keep going.'
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯决心在球门前变得更加冷静，这位切尔西前锋渴望在我们2-0战胜曼联的英超联赛中继续发挥他出色的个人能力。这位英格兰国脚在斯坦福桥下半场一开始就打破了僵局，打进了一个精彩的个人进球，帮助蓝军重回胜利之路。不过，尽管罗杰斯本赛季在所有比赛中打进了6个进球并贡献了4次助攻，但他相信自己的进攻能力还有很大的进步空间。罗杰斯说：“我认为在球门前更加冷静，在禁区内外更加无情，这是我以前对自己有点失望的事情，因为我偶尔会打进一个漂亮的进球，但我不会打进容易的进球。我正在尝试在这里做这件事。 “我正在努力改进我的最后动作，所以这是我最重要的动作。我是一名攻击手，所以我努力进球、助攻和创造机会，我想不断进步。我还没到那一步，但这是一个好的开始！”罗杰斯无疑在揭幕战中展现了自己的能力，他在中场接到罗密欧·拉维亚的传球，然后冲向客队的禁区。在埃斯特沃的支援下，这位 24 岁的球员发现了曼联后防线的空缺，突破了两次挑战，冷静地将球越过了塞内·拉门斯。他说：“我知道这是一个反击的机会，我认为埃斯特沃在外侧跑动了。我本来打算继续开车，我想和他比赛，但后来空间就打开了，我就继续前进。 “然后就是在球门前保持冷静，幸运的是球进了。”对于蓝军来说，这个进球是在一个重要时刻打进的，蓝军经历了艰难的上半场，然后在中场休息后控制了局面。科尔·帕尔默随后通过点球将我们的优势扩大了一倍，在最近对阵托特纳姆热刺队和利物浦队的比赛中遭遇挫折后，我们取得了一场可喜的胜利。虽然罗杰斯对自己的射门质量感到满意，但他对帮助球队全取三分感到更加满意。他补充道：“很高兴在比赛的重要时刻看到球入网。” “所以这对我来说是最重要的，我可以为比赛带来改变，最终我们会继续前进并赢得比赛，所以我很高兴。”在阿斯顿维拉效力两年后，罗杰斯接受了新的挑战，他正在享受在切尔西的生活，并相信球队将继续共同发展。 '我很喜欢它。这是一个不同的挑战，一个新的挑战，我真的很喜欢和这些出色的高素质球员一起比赛。 “这只是团队作为一个整体聚集在一起的问题。有好时光，也有坏时光，但我必须成为一个领导者，坚持我所知道的，并尽我所能。所以我们只需要继续前进。

news.title: Walsh excited by Chelsea's free-flowing attack after Charlton victory
news.title_zh: 沃尔什对查尔顿获胜后切尔西流畅的进攻感到兴奋
news.body_en: Keira Walsh believes Chelsea's attacking play is becoming increasingly free-flowing after producing a moment of individual brilliance in our emphatic 6-0 Women's Super League victory over Charlton Athletic. The England international was at the heart of another impressive performance from Sonia Bompastor's side, producing an audacious backheel assist for Aggie Beever-Jones as the Blues returned to the top of the WSL table. Chelsea scored four times inside the opening 19 minutes at The Valley before adding two more after the interval, and Walsh believes the confidence running through the squad is helping our attacking players flourish. 'I think the whole team feels confident,' said Walsh. 'I think some of the goals we scored today were really, really good. 'I think the team's just in a really, really good place. And I think especially in attack, it feels very free-flowing. I'm excited about it.' Walsh's creativity was on full display in the 57th minute when she improvised brilliantly to flick the ball into Beever-Jones' path, allowing the striker to finish clinically and register her first goal of the campaign. While the midfielder admitted her inventive pass was not necessarily intended for Beever-Jones, she was delighted to help her team-mate get among the goals. 'I was just trying to flick it for one of the runners in behind. I probably saw Sandy more, to be honest! I think it was a really good finish from Aggie. 'I think giving our strikers confidence, giving our forwards confidence to know that they can score those goals again, is really important.' Another player who enjoyed a memorable afternoon was Giulia Dragoni, who came off the bench to score her first competitive Chelsea goal with a superb finish in the 66th minute. Walsh, who previously crossed paths with the young Italian during her time at Barcelona, was full of praise for her team-mate's ability and attitude. 'For me, she's just an incredible person. I think she's just the best team-mate to have in the changing room. 'I think probably for her, she's been a little bit disappointed in her minutes, if she's being honest. But I think in terms of what she does for the team and the players who are playing, she's incredible. 'I think since she's come to Chelsea, she's been such a good talent in training. And I think you can see with her first touch and her finish. Her body was almost facing the opposite way and she could still find the bottom corner.' The midfielder also highlighted the collective joy at seeing Dragoni score, with the celebrations reflecting the close-knit nature of Bompastor's squad. 'I think you could see how happy the bench was for Giulia when she scored. So I think it just shows the togetherness of the team in general.' Despite our six-goal haul, Walsh was equally pleased with the defensive discipline shown by the Blues ahead of another important run of fixtures. 'I think a clean sheet was important today. I think that's something we've really been focusing on this year. And obviously scoring a lot of goals. 'Important going into some big games coming up. Really happy with the team performance.'
news.body_zh: 凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 认为，在女足超级联赛以 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技队的比赛中，切尔西队展现出了个人的辉煌时刻，之后她的进攻变得越来越流畅。这位英格兰国脚是索尼娅·邦帕斯托尔队另一场令人印象深刻的表现的核心人物，他为阿吉·比弗·琼斯送出了大胆的后脚跟助攻，帮助蓝军重回 WSL 积分榜榜首。切尔西在山谷球场开场 19 分钟内就打入四球，中场休息后又进了两球，沃尔什相信球队的自信正在帮助我们的进攻球员蓬勃发展。 “我认为整个团队都充满信心，”沃尔什说。 “我认为我们今天打进的一些进球真的非常非常好。 “我认为球队处于一个非常非常好的位置。我认为尤其是在进攻时，感觉非常自由。我对此感到很兴奋。沃尔什的创造力在第 57 分钟得到了充分展示，她出色地即兴发挥，将球弹到比弗-琼斯的路径上，让这位前锋冷静地射门，打进了她本赛季的第一个进球。虽然这位中场球员承认她创造性的传球不一定是为比弗-琼斯准备的，但她很高兴帮助她的队友取得进球。 “我只是想把它弹给后面的一名跑步者。老实说，我可能见桑迪的次数更多了！我认为阿吉的终结非常出色。 “我认为让我们的前锋有信心，让我们的前锋有信心知道他们可以再次进球，这非常重要。”另一位度过了难忘下午的球员是朱利亚·德拉戈尼 (Giulia Dragoni)，她在第 66 分钟替补出场，以精彩的射门打进了她在切尔西的第一个正式进球。沃尔什此前曾在巴塞罗那效力期间与这位年轻的意大利人有过交集，她对队友的能力和态度赞不绝口。 “对我来说，她是一个不可思议的人。我认为她是更衣室里最好的队友。 “我想，如果她说实话的话，对她来说，她在这段时间里可能有点失望。但我认为就她为球队和球员所做的事情而言，她是令人难以置信的。 “我认为自从她来到切尔西以来，她在训练方面一直表现得非常出色。我想你可以从她的第一次触球和她的终结中看到。她的身体几乎面向相反的方向，但她仍然可以找到底角。这位中场球员还强调了看到德拉戈尼进球时的集体喜悦，庆祝活动反映了邦帕斯托队的紧密团结。 “我想你可以看到，当朱莉娅进球时，替补席上的人是多么高兴。所以我认为这只是显示了整个团队的团结。”尽管我们取得了六粒进球，沃尔什对蓝军在另一场重要比赛之前表现出的防守纪律同样感到满意。 “我认为今天零失球很重要。我认为这是我们今年真正关注的事情。显然，他打进了很多球。 “重要的是要参加即将到来的一些大型比赛。对球队的表现非常满意。”

news.title: Bompastor provides Lauren James injury update and praises Blues after Charlton win
news.title_zh: 博姆帕斯托提供了劳伦·詹姆斯的最新伤情，并在查尔顿获胜后赞扬了蓝军
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has confirmed Lauren James will undergo further assessment after the Chelsea forward suffered a hamstring problem during our emphatic 6-0 Women's Super League victory over Charlton Athletic. James had been influential as the Blues raced into a four-goal lead inside the opening 19 minutes at The Valley, but pulled up while running for a through ball and was replaced by Erin Cuthbert shortly after the half-hour mark. Speaking after the game, Bompastor admitted it was too early to determine the severity of the injury. She said: 'It is difficult to say. I can only say it's her hamstring and we'll assess her later to have more detailed information. We'll probably need to assess her tomorrow. 'I think it's her hamstring, so we'll see what happens from tomorrow.' Despite that setback, there were plenty of positives for our head coach, including a memorable afternoon for Nathalie Bjorn. The Swedish defender captained the Blues on her first WSL start since November 2025 and marked her return with a towering header to open the scoring inside three minutes. 'Today I'm really pleased for Nat Bjorn,' said Bompastor. 'She's been injured for so long and she hasn't played much football in the past year. So I think for her to start the game and score an early goal was a big boost for her confidence, so it's nice.' Another player who enjoyed a special moment was Giulia Dragoni, who came off the bench to score her first competitive Chelsea goal with a superb finish in the 66th minute. The young Italian was visibly emotional after finding the net, and Bompastor believes her dedication behind the scenes made the moment particularly rewarding. Bompastor said: 'I think the emotion after the goal comes from the fact that she's been working really, really hard. 'She's a young talent. She had the opportunity to show that today when she came on, but also with the goal she scored. 'It's a great goal. The competition is high right now in the squad and she needs to stay patient. Even if today was a good 30 minutes on the pitch for her, a really positive performance, that's the only thing she can control. 'She can keep doing that to give me some headaches!'
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特确认劳伦·詹姆斯将接受进一步评估，此前切尔西前锋在我们以 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技的女足超级联赛中遭遇腿筋问题。詹姆斯在山谷球场开场 19 分钟内就取得了四球领先，蓝军在比赛中发挥了重要作用，但他在跑动直塞球时停了下来，半小时后不久就被艾琳·库斯伯特换下。赛后接受采访时，邦帕斯特承认现在判断伤势严重程度还为时过早。她说：“这很难说。我只能说是她的腿筋问题，我们稍后会对她进行评估以获得更详细的信息。明天我们可能需要对她进行评估。 “我认为这是她的腿筋，所以我们明天看看会发生什么。”尽管遭遇了挫折，我们的主教练还是看到了很多积极的一面，包括娜塔莉·比约恩度过了一个难忘的下午。这位瑞典后卫自 2025 年 11 月以来首次在 WSL 首发中担任蓝军队长，并在三分钟内以一记高耸的头球首开纪录。 “今天我真的为纳特·比约恩感到高兴，”邦帕斯特说。 “她受伤太久了，过去一年她没有踢太多足球。所以我认为对她来说，开始比赛并早早进球对她的信心来说是一个很大的提升，所以这很好。”另一位享受特殊时刻的球员是朱利亚·德拉戈尼(Giulia Dragoni)，她在第66分钟替补出场，以精彩的射门打进了她在切尔西的第一个正式进球。这位年轻的意大利人在进球后明显情绪激动，邦帕斯特相信她在幕后的奉献让这一刻特别有意义。邦帕斯特说：“我认为进球后的情绪来自于她一直非常非常努力的事实。 “她是一位年轻的天才。她今天有机会证明这一点，当她上场时，也用她的进球证明了这一点。 “这是一个伟大的目标。现在队里的竞争很激烈，她需要保持耐心。即使今天对她来说在球场上度过了美好的 30 分钟，表现非常积极，但这也是她唯一能控制的事情。 “她可以继续这样做让我头疼！”

news.title: Penders: It’s about how you react to setbacks
news.title_zh: Penders：这是关于你如何应对挫折
news.body_en: Mike Penders believes learning from mistakes is an important part of his development after bouncing back from a difficult afternoon against Tottenham Hotspur to help Chelsea secure a 2-0 victory over Manchester United. The Belgian goalkeeper endured disappointment in last weekend’s defeat to Spurs, when an unfortunate own-goal from a corner helped the visitors claim all three points at Stamford Bridge. But the 21-year-old has responded impressively, producing a string of fine saves against Liverpool in midweek before keeping a clean sheet in Saturday’s Premier League triumph over United. ‘To have something like that is part of football and part of my journey,’ Penders reflected on the Tottenham setback. ‘You will make mistakes, but then it’s about how you react, and I am very happy I could bring some positivity on the pitch today.’ Penders certainly played his part in our return to winning ways, making important interventions as United threatened during a closely contested first half. He twice denied Amad Diallo before producing arguably his finest moment deep into stoppage time, getting his fingertips to Bryan Mbeumo’s powerful effort from distance and diverting the ball onto the crossbar. It was a superb piece of goalkeeping that preserved our two-goal advantage and ensured the Blues finished the afternoon with a clean sheet. ‘It was a very hard shot and I didn’t see him coming,’ Penders explained. ‘But in the end, I was able to get my fingers onto it and I was very happy [to make that save].’ The victory was particularly welcome after consecutive defeats against Tottenham and Liverpool, the latter coming via a penalty shoot-out in the Carabao Cup. Penders was pleased with the character shown by Xabi Alonso’s side in responding to those setbacks. ‘I think as a team as well, we have reacted very well after the last two games. I think against Liverpool we played a good game, and today we did a great job.’ Saturday’s contest was far from straightforward, with United having a first-half goal from Matheus Cunha ruled out for offside. However, Morgan Rogers broke the deadlock shortly after the interval with a superb individual effort before Cole Palmer doubled our advantage from the penalty spot. For Penders, the key to securing all three points was maintaining composure, even when the visitors threatened. ‘I think we just played our football. We stayed calm and were very controlled in our game. I think that was very important. ‘Of course, sometimes they have chances. For example, the goal that was disallowed in the first half. But it’s important to keep your head in the game and that’s what we did. It was a good win for us.’
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯（Mike Penders）从对阵托特纳姆热刺队的艰难下午中恢复过来，帮助切尔西以 2-0 战胜曼联，他认为从错误中学习是他发展的重要组成部分。这位比利时门将在上周末输给热刺的比赛中感到失望，他在角球处的一个不幸的乌龙球帮助客队在斯坦福桥全取三分。但这位21岁的球员的表现令人印象深刻，在周中对阵利物浦的比赛中做出了一系列精彩扑救，然后在周六战胜曼联的英超比赛中保持零失球。 “拥有这样的东西是足球的一部分，也是我旅程的一部分，”潘德斯在谈到热刺的失利时说道。 “你会犯错误，但关键在于你如何反应，我很高兴今天能在场上带来一些积极的东西。”潘德斯在我们重回胜利之路的过程中发挥了重要作用，在上半场激烈的比赛中，当曼联发起威胁时，他做出了重要的干预。他两次挡出了阿马德·迪亚洛的射门，然后在伤停补时阶段创造了可以说是他最精彩的时刻，他用指尖接到布莱恩·姆博莫的远距离大力射门，并将球转移到横梁上。这是一次出色的守门，保住了我们的两球优势，并确保蓝军以零失球结束了下午的比赛。 “这是一次非常艰难的射门，我没有看到他来，”彭德斯解释道。 “但最终，我成功扑救了球，我很高兴（做出了扑救）。”在连续输给托特纳姆热刺队和利物浦队之后，这场胜利尤其受欢迎，后者是在联赛杯中通过点球大战获得的。彭德斯对哈维·阿隆索的球队在应对这些挫折时所表现出的性格感到满意。 “我认为作为一个团队，我们在过去两场比赛后的反应非常好。我认为对阵利物浦的比赛我们踢了一场精彩的比赛，今天我们做得很好。周六的比赛远非直截了当，曼联上半场马修斯·库尼亚的进球因越位被判无效。然而，摩根·罗杰斯在中场休息后不久凭借出色的个人表现打破了僵局，随后科尔·帕尔默在点球点上将我们的优势扩大了一倍。对于潘德斯来说，确保全取三分的关键是保持冷静，即使客队充满威胁。 “我认为我们只是踢了我们的足球。我们保持冷静，在比赛中控制得很好。我认为这非常重要。 “当然，有时他们有机会。比如上半场被判无效的进球。但重要的是要保持头脑清醒，这就是我们所做的。这对我们来说是一场很好的胜利。

news.title: Match report: Charlton Athletic 0-6 Chelsea Women
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：查尔顿竞技 0-6 切尔西女足
news.body_en: Chelsea returned to the top of the Women's Super League with a commanding 6-0 victory over Charlton Athletic, scoring four times inside the opening 19 minutes at The Valley. Captain Nathalie Bjorn headed us in front on her first league start for almost a year, before Melvine Malard struck twice either side of an Ellie Carpenter goal as the Blues raced into a four-goal lead. Half-time substitute Aggie Beever-Jones added a fifth, and Giulia Dragoni rounded off the scoring with her first competitive Chelsea goal to complete a dominant afternoon for Sonia Bompastor's side. The emphatic victory also extended our unbeaten start to the WSL campaign and moved us back above Manchester City on goal difference, after our title rivals had won earlier in the day. The only concern came when Lauren James, who had been outstanding during our blistering start, was forced off with an injury before half-time. Bompastor made seven changes from Wednesday's 2-0 UEFA Women's Champions League victory over Roma, with Bjorn returning to captain the side in her first WSL start since November 2025. The Sweden international has endured a frustrating spell with injuries but marked another significant step in her return to regular action in spectacular fashion. There was also a first Chelsea start for Manaka Matsukubo. The Japan international joined from North Carolina Courage during the summer, having been named the NWSL Midfielder of the Year in 2025, and made her Blues debut as a late substitute against Crystal Palace last weekend. Carpenter, Katie McCabe, Keira Walsh, Sjoeke Nusken and Malard were among the other players brought into the starting XI. We took just three minutes to break the deadlock. McCabe received the ball following a short corner and floated an inviting delivery into the penalty area, where Bjorn climbed highest to send a firm header into the net. We continued to pour forward and doubled our advantage in the 10th minute. Sandy Baltimore, a constant source of danger on the left, delivered a cross which struck Malard around the midriff and slipped past Charlton goalkeeper Anna Koivunen. Three minutes later, James tested Koivunen with an effort from outside the area. The goalkeeper could only push the ball into Carpenter's path, and the Australian finished confidently from close range for her fifth goal in all competitions this season. Matsukubo then passed up a promising opening as she searched for her first Chelsea goal, but there was little respite for the hosts. The fourth arrived in the 19th minute following a scramble in the Charlton box. Koivunen made a couple of saves as the Blues sought another way through, only for Malard to react quickest to the loose ball and turn home from a matter of yards. The French forward thought she had completed her hat-trick shortly afterwards, racing onto a superb James pass and finishing across goal, but the assistant referee's flag ruled it out for offside. James had been instrumental in our attacking display but was forced to pull up while running off the ball just after the half-hour mark and could not continue. Erin Cuthbert came on in her place. There was also a brief interruption when Nusken needed treatment after catching her finger on an advertising board. Charlton gradually steadied themselves after the opening onslaught and Jodie Hutton headed an opportunity off target, although Chelsea still enjoyed around 70 per cent of possession in the first half and did not allow the hosts a shot on target. Bompastor introduced Beever-Jones for Malard at half-time and Beever-Jones took her opportunity just before the hour mark. Walsh produced an inventive, instinctive backheel to send the forward through, and she finished calmly to register her first goal of the season, celebrating with visible delight. Bjorn, Walsh and Matsukubo were then withdrawn as Bompastor made three further changes, but the Blues remained on the front foot. Baltimore curled a wonderful effort against the woodwork, leaving Koivunen stranded, before Maika Hamano was denied by the post just moments later. Our sixth finally arrived in the 66th minute, when Dragoni finished a flowing move involving fellow substitutes with real composure. The young Italian, who joined Chelsea permanently from Barcelona in the summer, was overcome with emotion as she celebrated her first competitive goal for the club. Koivunen, making her WSL debut, recovered from a difficult opening to produce some impressive saves, including an excellent stop to deny Alyssa Thompson in the closing stages. Charlton continued to search for a consolation and Ashleigh Neville headed narrowly over from a late corner, but Hannah Hampton and the Blues defence held firm to secure a clean sheet. Chelsea have now won seven of our opening eight WSL matches, drawing the other, and return to the summit with 22 points. Our goal difference of plus 23 puts us ahead of Manchester City, who also have 22 points. We welcome Everton to Stamford Bridge in the Women's Super League on Saturday 7 November, with kick-off scheduled for 12.45pm. news.body_zh: 切尔西在山谷球场以 6-0 战胜查尔顿竞技，在开场 19 分钟内就打入四球，重返女足超级联赛榜首。队长纳塔莉·比约恩 (Nathalie Bjorn) 在近一年来的首次联赛首发中带领我们取得领先，随后梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 在艾莉·卡彭特 (Ellie Carpenter) 的进球两侧各进两球，帮助蓝军取得四球领先。半场替补出场的阿吉·比弗-琼斯攻入第五球，朱莉娅·德拉格尼打进她在切尔西的第一个有竞争力的进球，为索尼娅·邦帕斯特的球队完成了一个统治性的下午。这场重大胜利也延续了我们在 WSL 赛季中不败的开局，并在我们的冠军对手当天早些时候获胜后，以净胜球优势重新领先于曼城。唯一令人担忧的是劳伦·詹姆斯，他在我们火热的开局中表现出色，但在半场结束前因伤被迫下场。博姆帕斯托在周三 2-0 战胜罗马的欧洲女足冠军联赛中做出了七项调整，比约恩自 2025 年 11 月以来首次在 WSL 首发中回归担任队长。这位瑞典国脚经历了一段令人沮丧的伤病期，但以惊人的方式标志着她在回归常规赛场上又迈出了重要一步。松久保真中也首次在切尔西首发。这位日本国脚于今年夏天从北卡罗来纳州勇气队加盟，被评为2025年NWSL年度最佳中场球员，并在上周末对阵水晶宫的比赛中替补上场，完成了她的蓝军首秀。卡彭特、凯蒂·麦凯布、凯拉·沃尔什、斯乔克·努斯肯和马拉德都是首发阵容中的其他球员。我们只用了三分钟就打破了僵局。麦凯布在一个短角球后接球，将一记诱人的传球送入禁区，比约恩爬到最高处，将头球送入球网。我们继续向前推进，第10分钟将优势扩大一倍。桑迪·巴尔的摩（Sandy Baltimore）是左路的威胁源，他的传中击中了马拉德的中腹，并绕过了查尔顿门将安娜·科伊武宁（Anna Koivunen）。三分钟后，詹姆斯禁区外试射科伊武宁。门将只能将球推入卡彭特的路径，澳大利亚人自信地近距离射门，打进了她本赛季所有比赛中的第五个进球。松久保随后在寻找自己在切尔西的第一个进球时错过了一个充满希望的机会，但主队并没有得到喘息的机会。第四粒进球是在第 19 分钟查尔顿禁区内发生争抢后打进的。当蓝军寻求另一条出路时，科伊武宁做出了几次扑救，但马拉德对球的反应最快，并在距离球门仅几码的地方转身破门。这位法国前锋以为她很快就完成了帽子戏法，接到詹姆斯的精彩传球并越过球门完成射门，但助理裁判的旗帜以越位为由判罚无效。詹姆斯在我们的进攻表现中发挥了重要作用，但在半小时后被迫在无球跑动时拉起球，无法继续。艾琳·卡斯伯特接替了她的位置。当努斯肯的手指被广告牌抓住后需要治疗时，也出现了短暂的中断。查尔顿在开场猛攻后逐渐稳定下来，朱迪·赫顿(Jodie Hutton)头球攻门偏出目标，尽管切尔西在上半场仍享有约70%的控球率，并且没有让主队射门。庞帕斯托在半场休息时为马拉德换下比弗-琼斯，比弗-琼斯在比赛即将结束前抓住了机会。沃尔什创造性地、本能地用后脚跟将前锋送出，她平静地完成了本赛季的第一个进球，带着明显的喜悦庆祝。比约恩、沃尔什和松久保随后被撤下，邦帕斯特又进行了三项换人，但蓝军仍保持领先。巴尔的摩队的一记精彩射门击中门框，科伊武宁陷入困境，不久之后滨野麦卡的射门被门柱挡出。我们的第六个进球终于在第 66 分钟到来，德拉格尼以真正的镇静完成了替补队员的流畅动作。这位年轻的意大利人于今年夏天从巴塞罗那永久加盟切尔西，在庆祝她为俱乐部的第一个正式进球时，她激动不已。 科伊武宁首次亮相 WSL，从艰难的开局中恢复过来，做出了一些令人印象深刻的扑救，包括在最后阶段精彩地扑救了艾莉莎·汤普森。查尔顿继续寻求安慰，阿什利·内维尔在最后角球中头球稍稍高出，但汉娜·汉普顿和蓝军防守坚守，确保零失球。切尔西目前在 WSL 前 8 场比赛中赢了 7 场，战平另一场，并以 22 分重返榜首。我们净胜球+23，领先同样积22分的曼城。我们将于 11 月 7 日星期六在斯坦福桥欢迎埃弗顿队参加女子超级联赛，开球时间定于中午 12 点 45 分。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、比约恩（汤普森 62）、布尔曼、麦凯布、沃尔什（德拉戈尼 61）、努斯肯、松久保（滨野 62）、詹姆斯（卡斯伯特 35）、巴尔的摩、马拉德（比弗-琼斯 HT）未上场替补：彭、布坎南、青铜、卡普坦进球者：比约恩3、马拉德 10、19、卡彭特 13、比弗-琼斯 57、德拉格尼 66 查尔顿竞技：科伊武宁、约翰斯顿（长袍 79）、斯基尔斯（c）、洛巴托、梅森（瓦尔迪 58）、内维尔、范埃格蒙德（肯尼 46）、弗兰纳里、赫顿（洛克伍德 73）、科霍宁（菲茨杰拉德） 58), 戴维森未上场替补：怀特豪斯、尼尔森-艾耶、汉弗莱、阿扎罗黄牌：赫顿 50

news.title: Cole Palmer: People don't realise how good Romeo Lavia is
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默：人们没有意识到罗密欧·拉维亚有多好
news.body_en: Cole Palmer has described Romeo Lavia as one of his favourite midfielders in the world and believes his team-mate continues to be underappreciated by some. The Belgian midfielder was instrumental in Saturday's win, offering composure and quality in the centre of the pitch as the Blues improved after the interval to secure all three points. Lavia also helped create our opening goal, winning the ball back and feeding Morgan Rogers, who surged forward and lifted a fine finish over United goalkeeper Senne Lammens. And Palmer, who later doubled our advantage from the penalty spot, reserved special praise for his team-mate after the final whistle. 'Today was one of the best games I've seen him play,' said Palmer. 'I've said all along he's one of my favourite midfielders, and people still don't realise how good he is. 'Obviously he's had his injury problems, but he's trying to put that behind him now and put in performances like today. I thought he was the best player on the pitch.' Lavia's display was particularly encouraging given the injury setbacks which have interrupted his Chelsea career, with the 22-year-old now looking to build momentum through consistent performances. While it was a memorable afternoon for Lavia, the Blues had to work hard for the result. United created openings before the break, but our second-half response proved decisive. After Rogers opened the scoring, Palmer made it 2-0 from the spot following Lisandro Martinez's dismissal, and the Blues saw out the match to earn an important clean sheet. Reflecting on the team's performance, Palmer said: 'It was a tough first half, but I think second half we stepped up and I'm happy with the three points. 'Certainly [in the second half] we were less sloppy with the chances they were getting from us losing the ball. So we just played harder and created our chances.'
news.body_zh: 科尔·帕尔默将罗密欧·拉维亚描述为世界上他最喜欢的中场球员之一，并认为他的队友仍然被一些人低估。这位比利时中场球员在周六的胜利中发挥了重要作用，他在中场提供了冷静和能力，帮助蓝军在中场休息后取得进步，确保全取三分。拉维亚也帮助我们创造了首个进球，夺回球权并传球给摩根·罗杰斯，摩根·罗杰斯向前冲刺，漂亮地射门超越了曼联门将塞内·拉门斯。帕尔默后来在点球点上将我们的优势扩大了一倍，并在终场哨响后对他的队友表示了特别的赞扬。 “今天是我见过他打的最好的比赛之一，”帕尔默说。 “我一直说他是我最喜欢的中场球员之一，但人们仍然没有意识到他有多出色。 “显然他有伤病问题，但他现在正努力把伤病抛在脑后，并拿出像今天这样的表现。我认为他是球场上最好的球员。”考虑到伤病困扰中断了他在切尔西的职业生涯，拉维亚的表现尤其令人鼓舞，这位 22 岁的球员现在希望通过稳定的表现来积聚动力。虽然这对拉维亚来说是一个难忘的下午，但蓝军必须为结果而努力。曼联在中场休息前创造了空档，但我们下半场的反应证明是决定性的。罗杰斯首开纪录后，利桑德罗·马丁内斯被罚下场后，帕尔默将比分改写为2-0，蓝军最终完成了一场重要的零失球。谈到球队的表现，帕尔默表示：“上半场很艰难，但我认为下半场我们有所进步，我对三分感到满意​​。 “当然，（下半场）我们没有那么马虎，他们从我们丢球的机会中获得了机会。所以我们只是打得更加努力，创造了机会。”

Following our 2-0 UEFA Women's Champions League victory over Roma in midweek, the Blues return to domestic action with a trip across London to face the newly-promoted Addicks. Hannah Hampton retains her place in goal, with Nathalie Bjorn and Katie McCabe returning to the starting XI alongside Veerle Buurman. Ellie Carpenter also comes into the side after scoring in Wednesday's European victory. There are changes in midfield, with Sjoeke Nusken, Keira Walsh and Manaka Matsukubo all named in the starting line-up, while Erin Cuthbert and Wieke Kaptein are among the substitutes. Lauren James and Sandy Baltimore retain their places, with Melvine Malard returning to the starting XI after scoring twice in our last league outing against Crystal Palace. The Blues will be looking to maintain our unbeaten start to the Women's Super League season when we kick off at The Valley at 2.30pm. You can follow all the action as it happens in our Match Centre, while those in the UK can watch the game on BBC Two, BBC iPlayer and the BBC Sport website.
