news.title: Xabi Alonso reflects on a 'very important' clean sheet and stable Mike Penders
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索反思“非常重要”的零失球和稳定的迈克·彭德斯
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has emphasised the importance of the Blues keeping our second clean sheet in three Premier League matches and highlighted Mike Penders’ role in our victory over Manchester United. Our shutout in yesterday's game at Stamford Bridge was hard-earned. The visitors, particularly in the opening 45 minutes, created several goalscoring opportunities and Penders was tested on several occasions. He produced good stops to deny Amad Diallo, but the best came late in the game. With the Blues leading by two goals after Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer had found the net, Bryan Mbeumo rasped a 20-yard drive toward our goal. Penders produced a full-length dive as the ball ricocheted off the crossbar and was cleared. Only the slow-motion replay showed that the Belgian goalkeeper had got a small but decisive touch on the ball to divert it onto the woodwork and preserve our clean sheet. Alonso insisted that should not be taken lightly, with the Blues manager explaining after our win: '[The clean sheet] is very important, and it’s the second one in three Premier League games. 'We need many more and we don’t take them for granted. Three points and a clean sheet is good and we need to keep on repeating this scoreline.’ On Penders, he added: ‘Not just today, I think at Liverpool he was really solid. Mike had a very good performance today and was very stable for a goalkeeper. 'He has shown a good level [against Man United], and we kept another clean sheet, the second one in three games. Now we need to keep going. 'Mike has overcome the difficult moment that we had last Saturday and this is part of the development of any goalkeeper, or any player.’ The Blues return home after the international break to take on our old rivals, Leeds United. news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索强调了蓝军在三场英超比赛中第二次不失球的重要性，并强调了迈克·彭德斯在我们战胜曼联的过程中所发挥的作用。昨天在斯坦福桥的比赛中我们的绝杀来之不易。客队，尤其是在开场45分钟内，创造了多次进球机会，彭德斯也多次受到考验。他做出了漂亮的扑救，挡住了阿马德·迪亚洛的射门，但最好的一次是在比赛后期。摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默进球后，蓝军领先两球，布莱恩·姆博莫在 20 码外猛烈射门，直奔球门。彭德斯做出了一次全长俯冲，皮球从横梁上弹出并被解围。只有慢镜头回放显示，比利时守门员对球进行了小而决定性的触碰，将球转移到门框上，保住了我们的不失球。阿隆索坚持认为这不应该掉以轻心，蓝军主帅在我们获胜后解释道：“[零失球]非常重要，这是三场英超比赛中的第二场。 “我们需要更多，而且我们不会认为它们是理所当然的。三分和不失球就很好，我们需要继续重复这样的比分。”谈到潘德斯，他补充道：“不仅仅是今天，我认为他在利物浦的表现非常稳定。迈克今天的表现非常好，对于门将来说非常稳定。 “他（对阵曼联）表现出了很好的水平，我们又保持了不失球，这是三场比赛中的第二场。现在我们需要继续前进。 “迈克已经克服了我们上周六遇到的困难时刻，这是任何门将或任何球员发展的一部分。” 蓝军在国际比赛日结束后回到家乡，迎战我们的老对手利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Romeo Lavia on hard work paying off with ‘statement performance’
news.title_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚 (Romeo Lavia) 谈辛勤工作以“声明性表现”获得回报
news.body_en: Romeo Lavia believes Chelsea’s performance in the 2-0 victory over Manchester United laid down a marker for what he and the Blues are capable of this season. The Belgian was in fine form as we got back to winning ways at Stamford Bridge on Saturday and played an important part in the opening goal shortly after half-time. It was Lavia who halted a United attack with a crucial tackle and then reacted quickly to nip in and send the loose ball to Morgan Rogers. From there, Rogers powered forward through the Man Utd defence and lifted a composed finish over the keeper. Cole Palmer then added a second from the penalty spot to extend our lead and ensure it was the Blues who would take all three points. For Lavia, it was a performance which further underlined his growing momentum in the Chelsea midfield, as he continues to put a difficult period with injury behind him. ‘I like to say that my job is to make the job for the other players in front of me easier, and everyone around me,’ reflected Lavia. ‘So I'm happy I've been able to do that and help the team to get a good win. ‘I feel very comfortable. Like I've always said, it's been in the weeks a lot of work that goes unseen with everyone in the building, at the training ground. So I'm very happy that it's all paying off and hopefully it just continues this way.’ The win at the Bridge saw Chelsea bounce back from the double disappointment of last week’s loss to Tottenham Hotspur and the midweek Carabao Cup exit at Liverpool on penalties, with the added bonus of returning the Blues to the top four of the Premier League table, at least until Liverpool’s meeting with Arsenal on Sunday. ‘It was a very important game and important win,’ Lavia continued. ‘I think the team effort was amazing. Everyone, from the players who started to the players who came on, was engaged and I think that’s a good statement for what's ahead. ‘It was quite obvious that the chances that they had in the first half were coming from our mistakes, sometimes rushing things a little bit when we had the control. So the message was just to rectify that little detail in the second half and for the rest not to change anything. I think we did that and we got the clean sheet as well, so it's a very good win. ‘We’re very happy with the win, but we're not overthinking things. We are very focused and we know that it's a process. It's a good day, but a performance like this is a good statement of what we're capable of delivering.’ With Lavia completing his second full 90 minutes in the space of four days and Chelsea making it three wins from our last four Premier League games, it seems he and the team are beginning to hit their stride just as we approach the busy winter period. Our next home fixture after the international break sees us face Leeds United. Secure your place early with Club Chelsea. VIP tickets available now.
news.body_zh: 罗密欧·拉维亚相信切尔西在2-0战胜曼联的比赛中的表现为他和蓝军本赛季的能力奠定了基础。周六，当我们在斯坦福桥重回胜利之路时，比利时人状态良好，并在半场结束后不久的首个进球中发挥了重要作用。拉维亚用一次关键的拦截阻止了曼联的进攻，然后迅速做出反应，将球传给了摩根·罗杰斯。从那里开始，罗杰斯突破了曼联的防守，冷静地射门越过了门将。科尔·帕尔默随后罚进第二球，扩大了我们的领先优势，确保蓝军全取三分。对于拉维亚来说，这一表现进一步凸显了他在切尔西中场不断增长的势头，因为他仍在经历伤病的困难时期。 “我想说，我的工作就是让我面前的其他球员以及我周围的每个人的工作变得更容易，”拉维亚反映道。 “所以我很高兴我能够做到这一点并帮助球队取得一场精彩的胜利。 ‘我感觉很舒服。就像我一直说的那样，这几周以来，大楼里、训练场上的每个人都做了很多看不见的工作。所以我很高兴这一切都得到了回报，希望这样的情况能继续下去。”在桥上的胜利让切尔西从上周输给托特纳姆热刺和周中联赛杯点球大战中被利物浦淘汰的双重失望中恢复过来，还有一个额外的好处是让蓝军重返英超积分榜前四，至少在周日利物浦对阵阿森纳之前是这样。 “这是一场非常重要的比赛，也是一场重要的胜利，”拉维亚继续说道。 “我认为团队的努力是惊人的。每个人，从首发球员到替补球员，都非常投入，我认为这是对未来的一个很好的说明。 “很明显，他们上半场的机会来自于我们的失误，有时当我们控制局面时，我们的进攻有些仓促。所以这个信息只是在下半场纠正这个小细节，其余的不要改变任何东西。我认为我们做到了这一点，而且我们也零失球，所以这是一场非常好的胜利。 “我们对胜利感到非常高兴，但我们并没有想太多。我们非常专注，我们知道这是一个过程。这是美好的一天，但这样的表现很好地说明了我们的能力。”随着拉维亚在四天内完成了他的第二个完整的 90 分钟，切尔西在过去四场英超比赛中取得了三场胜利，似乎在我们接近繁忙的冬季时期时，他和球队开始大踏步前进。国际比赛日后的下一场主场比赛我们将对阵利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Alonso reveals Estevao plan after Brazilian's 'best response' against Man United
news.title_zh: 阿隆索在巴西人对阵曼联的“最佳回应”后透露了埃斯特沃计划
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso revealed Estevao Willian was told he would start against Manchester United at the beginning of the week, and praised the Brazilian for showing the ‘best response’ in our 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge. The 19-year-old was handed his first Premier League start of the campaign in today's lunchtime kick-off and produced an impressive display. He twice had the ball in the back of the net – only to be denied by the assistant referee and VAR – registered six shots, the joint-most by a Chelsea player in a top-flight game this season, and created three chances. Those inside Stamford Bridge gave Estevao a standing ovation when he was replaced by Malo Gusto in the closing minutes. Before he took his seat in the dugout, Estevao and Alonso shared a warm embrace. He was then congratulated by the Blues coaching staff and his team-mates. And after the victory, Alonso explained he had outlined to Estevao after last weekend's game against Tottenham Hotspur, and before our midweek Carabao Cup trip to Liverpool, that he had earmarked the Brazil international to start against United. ‘We knew earlier this week – you ask me but sometimes I can’t give you all the info,' Alonso said with a smile. 'We spoke after Tottenham and he knew he was going to be playing today. 'He had the best response and showed that he deserves more and that he was prepared, and that is what we want from our players. So we're very happy for him. He deserves to enjoy this game; he had a good connection with the crowd and was really close to scoring his goal. He fought really hard and at the end he was tired, but it has been a good day for him.’ With Joao Pedro sidelined due to a thigh injury, Alonso has had to tweak his frontline in our last three outings. He opted for Pedro Neto to lead his attack against United, with Estevao, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers in support. It was Rogers who broke the deadlock with a fine solo run. Palmer later converted a penalty after Lisandro Martinez had been sent off for a foul on Wesley Fofana. ‘I assess different situations, from what we were going to do against Liverpool, and what we were going to do [against Manchester United],' explained Alonso. 'I had an idea [that Estevao would start], and I had it clear that he could have a good impact today, and he has shown it. 'He was a threat, he created many chances and situations where we could score. He has shown it well today.' The Blues return home after the international break to take on our old rivals, Leeds United. Secure your place early with Club Chelsea. VIP tickets available now.
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索透露埃斯特沃·威廉被告知他将在本周初对阵曼联的比赛中首发，并赞扬巴西人在我们2-0战胜斯坦福桥的比赛中表现出了“最佳反应”。这位19岁的球员在今天的午餐时间开球，并在英超联赛中首次首发，并展现了令人印象深刻的表现。他两次将球打入球网，但均被助理裁判和 VAR 拒绝。他共射门 6 次，是本赛季顶级联赛中切尔西球员中射门次数最多的球员，并创造了 3 次机会。当埃斯特沃在最后几分钟被马洛·古斯托换下时，斯坦福桥内的球迷起立鼓掌。在他入座之前，埃斯特瓦奥和阿隆索热情拥抱。随后，蓝军教练组和队友们向他表示祝贺。胜利之后，阿隆索解释说，他在上周末对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛后以及周中联赛杯客场对阵利物浦之前向埃斯特沃表示，他已指定这位巴西国脚在对阵曼联的比赛中首发。 “我们本周早些时候就知道了——你问我，但有时我无法给你所有的信息，”阿隆索笑着说。 “我们在托特纳姆热刺队之后进行了交谈，他知道他今天要参加比赛。 “他做出了最好的回应，表明他应该得到更多，并且他已经做好了准备，这就是我们对球员的期望。所以我们为他感到非常高兴。他值得享受这场比赛；他与观众的关系很好，而且非常接近进球。他打得非常努力，最后他很累，但这对他来说是美好的一天。”若昂·佩德罗因大腿受伤而缺阵，阿隆索在我们过去的三场比赛中不得不调整他的锋线。他选择佩德罗·内托带领他对阵曼联的进攻，埃斯特沃、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯支持。罗杰斯凭借出色的单打打破了僵局。利桑德罗·马丁内斯因对韦斯利·福法纳犯规被罚下场后，帕尔默随后主罚点球。 “我评估了不同的情况，从我们对阵利物浦的比赛到我们对阵曼联的比赛，”阿隆索解释道。 “我有一个想法（埃斯特沃将首发），我很清楚他今天可以产生良好的影响，他已经证明了这一点。 “他是一个威胁，他创造了很多我们可以进球的机会和情况。他今天表现得很好。”蓝军在国际比赛日结束后回到家乡迎战我们的老对手利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Cole Palmer on Rogers' impact against Man United and love for Estevao
news.title_zh: 科尔·帕尔默谈罗杰斯对曼联的影响以及对埃斯特沃的热爱
news.body_en: Cole Palmer was full of praise for his Blues team-mate and friend Morgan Rogers after the duo scored the goals that gave Chelsea victory over Manchester United, and also had words for Estevao Willian after the Brazilian’s return to the starting XI. The Blues secured a 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge in Saturday’s early Premier League kick-off, with Palmer and Rogers helping make up for the absence of striker Joao Pedro by both finding the back of the net. Palmer did so from the penalty spot, getting his 50th Premier League goal for the club on his 105th appearance. Only Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink and Diego Costa have reached that landmark faster. That came after Rogers had opened the scoring early in the second half. Romeo Lavia won possession in midfield, allowing the England international to pick up the ball and carry it almost the entire length of the Man Utd half, before lifting a deft finish over goalkeeper Senne Lammens. ‘That's what he does, you know,’ Palmer responded with a shrug and a smirk when asked about Rogers’ latest stunning goal for the Blues. ‘He gets the ball between the lines and when he drives he makes things happen. He went all the way himself and it was a great finish.’ With Pedro Neto taking on the centre forward role against the Red Devils, Estevao Willian came into the attack on the wing, making his first Premier League start of the season. The Brazilian made the most of his opportunity, producing several eye-catching moments and finding the back of the net twice, only to have the goals ruled out for offside, the second for the narrowest of VAR calls. ‘He needed to be patient for his moment and he got his moment today,’ Cole said of Estevao’s performance. ‘You could see in moments he was very good. ‘He was unlucky with the offside; I think it was literally a centimetre. But we know the talent he's got and we all love him. So hopefully he can continue like that.’ It was an important three points for Chelsea, dismissing the memories of last week’s loss to Tottenham Hotspur and the midweek Carabao Cup exit at Liverpool on penalties. The result also moves us back into the top four – at least temporarily – and makes it three wins from four matches in the Premier League since the last international break. ‘It was very important to get back to winning ways, obviously after the last defeat, so it's good,’ added Palmer, before explaining what changed in the second half to allow us to break the deadlock and win the game. ‘I just think we were more intense. The chances they had were from us losing the ball, so we tried to play a bit smarter, a bit sharper and not losing the ball as easily, and I think it helped.’ The Blues return home after the international break to take on our old rivals, Leeds United. news.body_zh: 在他的蓝军队友兼朋友摩根·罗杰斯进球帮助切尔西战胜曼联后，科尔·帕尔默对他的蓝军队友和朋友摩根·罗杰斯赞不绝口，并在巴西人重返首发阵容后对埃斯特沃·威廉说了一番话。周六英超联赛开赛初期，蓝军在斯坦福桥以 2-0 获胜，帕尔默和罗杰斯双双破门，弥补了前锋若昂·佩德罗的缺席。帕尔默在点球点上做到了这一点，这是他在第 105 场比赛中为俱乐部打入的第 50 个英超进球。只有吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克和迭戈·科斯塔更快地达到了这一里程碑。这是在罗杰斯下半场早些时候首开纪录之后。罗密欧·拉维亚在中场赢得了控球权，让这位英格兰国脚接球并带球几乎走过了曼联半场，然后灵巧地射门越过了门将塞内·拉门斯。 “你知道，这就是他所做的，”当被问及罗杰斯最近为蓝军打进的令人惊叹的进球时，帕尔默耸耸肩，笑着回答。 “他把球传到两条线之间，当他突破时，他就能让事情发生。他自己一路走来，这是一个伟大的终结。”在对阵红魔的比赛中，佩德罗·内托担任中锋，埃斯特沃·威廉在边路发起进攻，这是他本赛季在英超的首次首发。巴西人充分利用了自己的机会，创造了几个引人注目的时刻，并两次破门，但都因越位而被判无效，这是 VAR 判罚最窄的第二个进球。 “他需要对自己的时刻保持耐心，今天他得到了自己的时刻，”科尔在谈到埃斯特沃的表现时说道。 “你很快就能看出他非常出色。 “他运气不好，越位了；我认为它实际上是一厘米。但我们知道他的才华，我们都爱他。所以希望他能继续这样。”这对切尔西来说是重要的三分，让人们忘记了上周输给托特纳姆热刺队和周中联赛杯点球大战中被利物浦淘汰的记忆。这一结果也让我们重新回到前四——至少是暂时的——并且使我们自上次国际比赛日以来在英超联赛的四场比赛中取得了三场胜利。 “回到胜利之路非常重要，显然是在上次失利之后，所以这很好，”帕尔默补充道，然后解释了下半场发生的变化，让我们打破了僵局并赢得了比赛。 “我只是认为我们更加激烈。他们的机会来自于我们丢球，所以我们尝试踢得更聪明、更犀利，不那么容易丢球，我认为这很有帮助。” 国际比赛日结束后，蓝军回到主场迎战我们的老对手利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso praised the reaction of his Chelsea players against Manchester United after stressing his side needed to ‘win this game with the ball’ at half-time in our 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge. For 45 minutes at Stamford Bridge, little separated the two sides. Possession was evenly shared and while we registered seven shots, three of which were on target, United managed nine, with Mike Penders worked on three occasions. However, after the break, it was a different story. We broke the deadlock in the 50th minute through a fine solo goal from Morgan Rogers and doubled our advantage when Cole Palmer converted from the penalty spot after Lisandro Martinez was sent off for a foul on Wesley Fofana. Naturally, United's reduction to 10 men influenced how the contest played out, but we had 67 per cent of the ball in the second period and fired 11 shots at the United goal. The visitors, in contrast, managed just three. Alonso emphasised after the win that, at the interval, he had stressed to his players the importance of controlling the game through possession, which he felt his players implemented impressively. ‘I think that there were different moments in the game,' the Blues manager said. 'The first half was intense, with momentum for both sides. United had their chances and we were close as well. At half-time, we spoke and the reaction in the second half was better. 'We started quite well, got the lead, and we looked in better control. After it went 2-0 and the red card the context of the game changed, but it was not easy.’ Alonso continued: 'When we spoke at half-time, we said we were going to win this game with the ball, so the improvement has been with the ball. The message was to be better with the ball and to not give away that much. 'We changed some tactical things, but we were more comfortable on the pitch with better control. When you feel better with the ball, normally the better you are defending as well. 'So I think that reaction, that change, has been important for the feeling and the goal as well.’ Alonso opted to start without an orthodox striker against United. Pedro Neto was tasked with leading the line, while Palmer, Rogers and Estevao Willian operated effectively behind the Portuguese international. 'We need to be creative sometimes to find solutions with the players available,' said the Blues manager. 'Pedro has worked really hard in that position. It’s not new to him, linking up with the players around him. 'There were moments [in the first half], but I would say, especially at the start of the second half and what we had spoken about at half-time, the reaction was good.' news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索赞扬了切尔西球员对阵曼联的反应，他在半场结束时强调球队需要“用球赢得这场比赛”，帮助我们2-0战胜斯坦福桥。在斯坦福桥的 45 分钟里，双方几乎没有分出胜负。控球权是平均分配的，虽然我们有 7 次射门，其中 3 次射中目标，但曼联却射门 9 次，而迈克·彭德斯则射门 3 次。然而，休息之后，情况就不同了。第 50 分钟，摩根·罗杰斯 (Morgan Rogers) 的精彩个人进球打破了僵局，利桑德罗·马丁内斯 (Lisandro Martinez) 对韦斯利·福法纳 (Wesley Fofana) 犯规被罚下场后，科尔·帕尔默 (Cole Palmer) 点球命中，我们的优势扩大了一倍。当然，曼联减少到 10 人的人数影响了比赛的结果，但我们在第二节中控球率为 67%，并向曼联球门射了 11 次射门。相比之下，客队只做到了三分。阿隆索在获胜后强调，在中场休息时，他向球员们强调了通过控球控制比赛的重要性，他认为他的球员们执行得非常出色。 “我认为比赛中有不同的时刻，”蓝军主教练说。 “上半场比赛非常激烈，双方都充满了动力。曼联有机会，我们也很接近。中场休息时，我们进行了交谈，下半场的反应更好了。 “我们开局很好，取得了领先，而且我们看起来控制得更好。在比分变成2-0和红牌之后，比赛的背景发生了变化，但这并不容易。”阿隆索继续说道：“当我们在半场讲话时，我们说我们将用球赢得这场比赛，所以进步是在球方面的。传达的信息是要更好地控球，并且不要放弃太多。 “我们改变了一些战术，但我们在球场上更舒服，控制也更好。当你控球感觉更好时，通常你的防守也会越好。 “所以我认为这种反应、这种变化对于感觉和目标也很重要。”阿隆索选择在对阵曼联的比赛中没有正统前锋的情况下首发。佩德罗·内托的任务是带头，而帕尔默、罗杰斯和埃斯特沃·威廉则在这位葡萄牙国脚身后有效地运作。 “我们有时需要发挥创造力，找到现有球员的解决方案，”蓝军主帅说道。 “佩德罗在这个位置上工作非常努力。与周围的球员联系对他来说并不新鲜。 “（上半场）有一些时刻，但我想说，特别是在下半场开始时以及我们在半场休息时谈到的事情，反应很好。”蓝军在国际比赛日结束后回到家乡迎战我们的老对手利兹联。尽早锁定切尔西俱乐部的席位。 VIP 票现已发售。

news.title: Match report: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：切尔西 2-0 曼联
news.body_en: A wonderful individual goal from Morgan Rogers and a Cole Palmer penalty were enough for the Blues to see off 10-man Manchester United at Stamford Bridge and get back to winning ways in the Premier League. The 90 minutes certainly didn't lack drama. Nor goalscoring opportunities. In the opening period, Estevao Willian had the ball in the net for the Blues, as did Matheus Cunha for United. Yet the goals were both ruled out for offside. Xabi Alonso's side took control after the break – and we broke the deadlock in some style. Rogers collected the ball in midfield, breezed past Harry Maguire and Lisandro Martinez, and clipped a finish over Senne Lammens. Our second arrived in the 64th minute, with Palmer converting from 12 yards. The penalty was awarded after a VAR review for Martinez elbowing Wesley Fofana from a corner. The Argentine defender was shown a second yellow card and a red for the incident. With a man and a two-goal advantage, the Blues were certain of the points. We appeared to have added a third goal when Estevao powered a finish into the roof of the net, but he was denied by a VAR review for offside. It didn't change the outcome of the contest, as after two painful defeats in league and cup, we got back on track and claimed the three points. Alonso made four alterations to his side. Marco Palestra made his first Premier League start, Levi Colwill returned to the defence, and Palmer and Estevao Willian were included in the attack. Malo Gusto, Maxence Lacroix, Jordan Henderson, who was absent through illness, and Danny Welbeck dropped out of the starting XI The opening 45 minutes ebbed and flowed. The Blues fashioned chances; United did the same. Sustained pressure was fleeting. Estevao fired the first warning shot of the afternoon. The winger cut inside onto his stronger right foot and whipped a shot toward the far corner. Senne Lammens was beaten, but the ball flew wide. United responded with an attempt of their own. A neat move around our penalty box saw Bruno Fernandes tee up former Blue Andrey Santos, and the midfielder guided a shot narrowly wide. Throughout the opening period, opportunities arrived via counter-attacks, and in the 14th minute, one led to what appeared to be our opening goal. Estevao launched a break and fed Pedro Neto, who forced a save from Lammens. The Brazilian converted the rebound from close range, only for the offside flag to be raised. From United's next attack, launched following a Chelsea corner, Bryan Mbeumo played an expertly weighted crossfield pass to Fernandes. The Portuguese controlled but skewed his shot high and wide. Fernandes looked to return the favour to Mbeumo soon after, flashing the ball across the Blues' six-yard box. Yet the United forward couldn't react to finish. It was a let-off. A flurry of United chances followed. First, Mike Penders reacted well to push clear a powerful low shot from Amad Diallo, and Josh Acheampong did well on the rebound to deny Matheus Cunha. Amad then forced Penders into a near-post stop. A key moment in the game arrived ten minutes before the interval. Maguire met a back-post corner and Matheus Cunha was able to nod the ball past Penders from close range. The United forward celebrated, as did his team-mates. Then came a VAR review: the Brazilian was offside and the goal was ruled out. United continued to threaten, and Amad twice came close either side of Moises Caicedo striking the base of the post from an Estevao corner. Wesley Fofana denied the United winger with an excellent block, and from his second attempt, the winger missed a one-on-one with Penders. The final opportunities of the opening period were ours. Neto first robbed Maguire in his own defensive third, broke into the box and tried to finish. Unfortunately, his far-post attempt flew wide. Estevao then drew a save from Lammens to draw the half to a close. Alonso opted against any substitutions at the break – and five minutes after the restart was rewarded as the Blues broke the deadlock. It was quite the goal. The impressive Romeo Lavia did excellently to win back possession in midfield and laid a pass to Rogers, who began to advance 35 yards from goal. The England international wasn't challenged, then eased beyond Maguire and Martinez into the box, and lifted a deft finish over Lammens. With momentum and confidence, the Blues then took – and did not relinquish – control. It was one-way traffic, with Penders hardly tested. Lammens was far busier. He first had to deny a header from Neto, and then had to be alert to avoid being caught out by an Estevao corner destined for the net. Pressure was building on the United goal. We earned a corner that Estevao delivered to the back post and, under pressure from Martinez, Fofana fell to the ground holding his face. Another corner was awarded, but VAR intervened. Referee Peter Bankes went to the monitor and, following a review, awarded a penalty. Martinez was shown a second yellow card and then a red. United were down to ten – and moments later were two goals behind as Palmer powered his spot-kick through Lammens. From then on, it was clear the three points would be staying at Stamford Bridge. Only the final scoreline was uncertain. The Blues supporters did have the chance to celebrate a third goal as, after winning the ball back in United's half, Palmer slipped a pass through to Estevao, who advanced and drilled a shot into the roof of the net. The Brazilian celebrated with his team-mates and Alonso, but following a delayed VAR review, the goal was ruled out for a marginal offside. Estevao was determined to get his name on the score-sheet, though, and twice forced Lammens into good stops. The second was a powerful effort that required a full-length stop. Alonso shuffled his pack as the half progressed. Pep Chavarria was introduced for Palestra; Malo Gusto, Valentin Barco and Danny Welbeck came on late for Caicedo, Estevao and Neto. Ten minutes were added. They didn't pass without incident. First, Mbeumo thumped a shot against the crossbar from 20 yards before the Blues cleared. Replays showed Penders got the merest of touches to deflect it onto the woodwork. An impressive run forward from Acheampong and a neat pass from Chavarria then presented Palmer with a chance, but he curled his effort over. Barco then missed the final chance of the contest, firing wide from close range after a Gusto cross. The Blues have a full week to prepare for our next top-flight fixture, which comes next weekend as we travel to Sunderland on 8 November. Our next home fixture is against Leeds United in the Premier League on Saturday 21 November and you can secure your place at Stamford Bridge early with Club Chelsea, as VIP tickets are available here now. news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯的精彩个人进球和科尔·帕尔默的点球足以让蓝军在斯坦福桥击败十人曼联，重回英超胜利之路。 90分钟当然不乏戏剧性。也没有进球机会。开局阶段，蓝军的埃斯特沃·威廉和曼联的马修斯·库尼亚都有进球。然而这两个进球均因越位而被判无效。哈维·阿隆索的球队在中场休息后控制了局面——我们以某种方式打破了僵局。罗杰斯在中场接球，轻松越过哈里·马奎尔和利桑德罗·马丁内斯，并越过塞内·拉门斯完成射门。我们的第二个进球出现在第 64 分钟，帕尔默在 12 码处射门。马丁内斯在角球中肘击韦斯利·福法纳，经VAR审查后判罚点球。阿根廷后卫因这一事件被出示第二张黄牌和一张红牌。凭借一人之力和两球优势，蓝军稳取积分。当埃斯特沃将球射入网顶时，我们似乎又进了第三个进球，但他被 VAR 判定越位无效。这并没有改变比赛的结果，在联赛和杯赛两场惨痛的失利之后，我们回到了正轨并拿下了三分。阿隆索对他的球队进行了四处改动。马尔科·帕莱斯特拉首次在英超首发，列维·科尔威尔回到后防线，帕尔默和埃斯特沃·威廉参与进攻。马洛·古斯托、马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦、因病缺席的乔丹·亨德森和丹尼·维尔贝克退出首发阵容。开场 45 分钟时长时长。蓝军创造了机会；曼联也做了同样的事情。持续的压力转瞬即逝。埃斯特沃开了下午的第一声警告枪。这位边锋用他更强的右脚切入内线，向远角射门。塞内·拉门斯被打，但皮球偏出。曼联也做出了回应。布鲁诺·费尔南德斯在禁区附近巧妙的移动，与前蓝军安德烈·桑托斯开球，这名中场球员的射门稍稍偏出。整个开场阶段，我们都通过反击获得了机会，第14分钟，我们就取得了看似首开纪录的进球。埃斯特沃发起突破，传球给佩德罗·内托，后者迫使拉门斯做出扑救。巴西人近距离反弹，但越位旗被举起。曼联在切尔西角球后发动下一次进攻，布莱恩·姆博莫（Bryan Mbeumo）向费尔南德斯巧妙地传球。葡萄牙人控制住了射门，但射门偏高且偏出。费尔南德斯很快就想要回报姆博莫，他将球闪过了蓝军的六码禁区。然而这位曼联前锋却无法做出反应来完成比赛。这是一种放纵。随后曼联获得了一连串机会。首先，迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders）反应良好，挡开了阿马德·迪亚洛（Amad Diallo）的强力低射，乔什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong）在篮板球上表现出色，挡出了马修斯·库尼亚（Matheus Cunha）。阿马德随后迫使彭德斯在近门柱处停下。比赛的关键时刻在中场休息前十分钟到来。马奎尔接到后门柱角球，马修斯·库尼亚近距离将球顶过彭德斯。曼联前锋和他的队友们都庆祝了。随后VAR审核：巴西人越位，进球无效。曼联继续制造威胁，阿马德两次逼近莫伊塞斯·凯塞多接埃斯特沃角球击中门柱底部。韦斯利·福法纳以出色的拦截挡出了曼联边锋的防守，但在第二次尝试中，这名边锋错过了与彭德斯的一对一。开局阶段的最后机会是我们的。内托首先在自己的防守三分中抢断了马奎尔，闯入禁区并试图完成射门。不幸的是，他的远门柱射门偏出。埃斯特沃随后被拉门斯扑出，半场比赛结束。阿隆索在中场休息时选择不进行任何换人，而在比赛重新开始五分钟后，蓝军打破了僵局。这确实是目标。令人印象深刻的罗密欧·拉维亚在中场出色地夺回控球权，并将球传给罗杰斯，罗杰斯开始向球门推进 35 码。这位英格兰国脚没有受到任何挑战，然后轻松越过马奎尔和马丁内斯进入禁区，并以灵巧的射门战胜了拉门斯。凭借动力和信心，蓝军随后取得了控制权，并且没有放弃。这是单向交通，彭德斯几乎没有经过测试。拉门斯要忙得多。 他首先必须挡住内托的头球，然后必须保持警惕，避免被埃斯特瓦奥的角球挡出。曼联进球的压力越来越大。我们获得了一个角球，埃斯特沃将球传到后门柱，在马丁内斯的压力下，福法纳捂着脸倒在地上。又判了一个角球，但VAR介入了。裁判彼得·班克斯走到监视器前，经过审查后判罚点球。马丁内斯被出示第二张黄牌，然后被出示红牌。曼联的比分落后到十个，不久之后，帕尔默通过拉门斯主罚点球，落后两球。从那时起，很明显三分将留在斯坦福桥。只是最终的比分还不确定。蓝军球迷确实有机会庆祝第三个进球，在曼联半场夺回球权后，帕尔默将球传给埃斯特沃，埃斯特沃向前推进，射门入网。巴西人与队友和阿隆索一起庆祝，但在VAR审查延迟后，进球因越位而被判无效。不过，埃斯特沃决心让自己的名字出现在进球表上，并两次迫使拉门斯取得好成绩。第二次是一次强有力的努力，需要完全停止。随着上半场的进行，阿隆索洗牌了他的背包。 Palestra 引入了 Pep Chavarria；马洛·古斯托、瓦伦丁·巴尔科和丹尼·维尔贝克替补凯塞多、埃斯特沃和内托出场。又增加了十分钟。他们并没有平安无事地通过。首先，姆博莫在20码外射门击中横梁，随后蓝军解围。重播显示，彭德斯只需轻轻一触，就能将球偏转到门框上。阿奇姆蓬 (Acheampong) 的一次令人印象深刻的前插和查瓦里亚 (Chavarria) 的一次漂亮传球给帕尔默带来了机会，但他的射门被扑出。巴科随后错过了比赛的最后机会，在古斯托传中后近距离射门偏出。蓝军有一整周的时间来准备我们的下一场顶级联赛，这场比赛将于下周末我们于 11 月 8 日前往桑德兰进行。我们的下一场主场比赛是 11 月 21 日星期六在英超联赛中对阵利兹联队，您可以提前在斯坦福桥获得切尔西俱乐部的席位，因为现在可以在这里购买 VIP 门票。切尔西：彭德斯； news.title: Under-18 Premier League report: West Ham 5-3 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 18岁以下英超联赛报告：西汉姆联5-3切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s suffered our first defeat in almost two months as, despite goals from Heze Grimwade, Ibrahim Rabbaj and Riley Ebho, the Blues were beaten by West Ham United. We started superbly, asking plenty of questions of the hosts' backline, and broke the deadlock in the 26th minute through yet another Grimwade set piece. Rabbaj claimed our second with a placed finish into the left corner just after the half-hour mark, but the score was 2-1 at the break as Tyrone Omotoye pulled a goal back for the hosts. In the second period, we re-established our two-goal lead thanks to Ebho. Unfortunately, West Ham scored three goals in six minutes to make it 4-3 and, while we tried to equalise, the Hammers had the final say as they netted their fifth of the afternoon. The Blues came racing out the blocks, piling pressure on West Ham’s backline. Within seven minutes, we had earned three corners, and our pressure midway through the half was after Rabbaj received the ball on the right flank and made a darting run towards the penalty area. His quick feet and pace were too much for the West Ham defence, who were forced to foul the Moroccan in a dangerous area. Grimwade stepped up and continued to prove himself as a free-kick specialist, firing the ball into the far corner. Rabbaj extended our lead five minutes later, netting his first goal of the season. Jayden Malundama came close to marking his return to the starting eleven with a goal but was thwarted by Felix Lewis-Ayesta. The loose ball fell to the edge of the box and Rabbaj picked his spot perfectly. He almost had a brace before the interval when he spotted the Hammers keeper off his line at the start of another attack. Rabbaj went for the spectacular from the halfway line and wasn’t far away, his effort whistled just wide of the right post. However, in the final action of the half, West Ham made it 2-1 through Omotoye. Hungry for more in the second period, Rabbaj kept testing Lewis-Ayesta and troubling the opposition. We had an array of chances, with Andrew Pennie unlucky not to turn his header toward goal and Jashayde Greenwood a whisker away from close range. It was Ebho who got our third, though, as he collected the ball off Grimwade and let fly from distance. His effort took a deflection and beat Lewis-Ayesta to reinstate our two-goal advantage. It wasn't one we were able to keep, though. With 20 minutes remaining, we were caught in possession and Jude Longman halved the deficit once more. The Blues responded well initially, as Greenwood's thumping strike was tipped onto the crossbar by Lewis-Ayesta, earning us a corner. Unfortunately, we were caught on the counter and punished as Omotoye got his second of the afternoon and equalised for the Hammers. Moments after the leveller, we conceded a penalty which Longman converted to put us behind for the first time in the contest. We pushed for an equaliser but West Ham managed a fifth before the final whistle to inflict our first defeat since the start of September. This defeat sees us remain on 21 points but we are still top of the Under-18 Premier League South table. We lead by a point having played one extra game than second place. Chelsea Under-18s host Charlton Athletic in the Premier League Cup on Saturday 7 November at Cobham Training Ground. The game gets underway at 11am GMT and supporters can watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription. news.body_zh: 切尔西 18 岁以下青年队遭遇近两个月来的首场失利，尽管赫泽·格里姆韦德、易卜拉欣·拉巴伊和莱利·埃博进球，但蓝军还是被西汉姆联队击败。我们开局非常出色，对主队的后防线提出了很多问题，并在第 26 分钟通过格里姆韦德的另一个定位球打破了僵局。半小时后，拉巴伊在左侧角球中射门，取得了我们的第二个进球，但中场休息时，蒂龙·奥莫托耶为主队扳回一球，比分变为 2-1。在第二节，我们凭借埃博重新确立了两球领先优势。不幸的是，西汉姆联队在六分钟内连进三球，将比分改写为4-3，当我们试图扳平比分时，铁锤帮拥有最终决定权，他们打进了下午的第五粒进球。蓝军冲出禁区，给西汉姆联的后防线施加压力。七分钟之内，我们就获得了三个角球，半场中段我们的压力来自于拉巴伊在右翼接球后冲向禁区。他的快速脚步和速度让西汉姆联的防守难以承受，西汉姆联被迫在危险区域对摩洛哥人犯规。格里姆韦德挺身而出，继续证明自己是任意球专家，将球射入远角。五分钟后，拉巴伊扩大了我们的领先优势，打进了他本赛季的第一个进球。杰登·马伦达马 (Jayden Malundama) 差点凭借一粒进球重返首发十一人名单，但被菲利克斯·刘易斯·阿耶斯塔 (Felix Lewis-Ayesta) 挫败。球落到了禁区边缘，拉巴伊完美地选准了自己的位置。中场休息前，当他在另一次进攻开始时发现铁锤队门将出线时，他几乎梅开二度。拉巴伊在中场线发起了精彩的射门，距离不远，他的射门稍稍偏出右门柱。然而，在半场最后一搏中，西汉姆联通过奥莫托耶将比分改写为2-1。在第二节中，拉巴伊渴望更多，他不断考验刘易斯-阿耶斯塔，给对手制造麻烦。我们有很多机会，安德鲁·彭尼不幸没有将头球转向球门，而贾沙伊德·格林伍德则距离近距离只有一步之遥。不过，埃博获得了我们的第三个进球，他从格里姆韦德手中接过球，然后从远处飞出。他的射门发生了偏转并击败了刘易斯-阿耶斯塔，恢复了我们的两球优势。但这不是我们能够保留的。还剩 20 分钟时，我们控球，裘德·朗曼再次将比分差距缩小。蓝军一开始反应不错，格林伍德的大力射门被刘易斯-阿耶斯塔击中横梁，为我们赢得了角球。不幸的是，我们被对手抓住并受到惩罚，奥莫托耶获得了下午的第二个进球，并为铁锤帮扳平了比分。扳平比分后不久，我们丢了一个点球，朗曼主罚点球，使我们在比赛中首次落后。我们力争扳平比分，但西汉姆联队在终场哨响前打进第五球，这是我们自九月初以来的首次失利。这场失利让我们仍积 21 分，但我们仍然在 18 岁以下英超南区积分榜上名列前茅。我们比第二名多踢了一场比赛，领先一分。切尔西 18 岁以下青年队将于 11 月 7 日星期六在科巴姆训练场举行英超联赛杯比赛，主场迎战查尔顿竞技队。比赛将于格林威治标准时间上午 11 点开始，支持者可以通过 CFC+ 订阅观看比赛直播。切尔西（4-3-3）：托比·贝尔； Riley Ebho (Gabriel Sambou60’)、Dante Waite (Josh Henry 64’) (C)、Jacob Hall、Yisa Alao；艾萨克·巴杜 (Isaac Badu)、杰登·马伦达马 (Jayden Malundama)（比拉尔·沙赫-贝尔库兹 79’）、赫泽·格里姆瓦德 (Heze Grimwade)；易卜拉欣·拉巴伊、贾沙伊德·格林伍德、安德鲁·彭尼（艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里 60’）未上场替补：伊萨戈·席尔瓦、里科·西利得分：格里姆韦德 26、拉巴伊 31、埃博 54 黄牌：马伦达马 45、拉巴伊 68、麦吉尔瓦里 70、巴杜 89 西汉姆联 (4-3-3)：菲利克斯刘易斯-阿耶斯塔；艾萨克·托姆斯、托马斯·乔尼拉（扎克·马戈万 83’）、阿纳尔多·巴托·乌加特、雷恩·史密斯；雷金纳德-雷·阿吉曼 (Reginald-Ray Agyemang)、泰隆·奥莫托耶 (Tyrone Omotoye)、裘德·朗曼 (Oluwadarasimi Akinlolu 87’)；马丁·佩切夫、丘克·奥比、杰夫塔·梅迪恩未上场替补：查尔斯·加兹登、杰克·汤姆林、米切尔·布朗、兰尼·诺布尔、格伦·麦卡杰得分：奥莫托耶 45+2 74、朗曼 71、77、阿金洛鲁 90+4 黄牌：乌盖特 13、乔尼拉 20、马高万 85、梅迪恩 90+4

news.title: Xabi Alonso explains Jordan Henderson absence against Man United
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索解释乔丹·亨德森缺席对阵曼联的比赛
news.body_en: Ahead of facing Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, Xabi Alonso explained why Jordan Henderson isn’t involved and why now was the right time for Estevao Willian to come into the starting XI. Our manager made four changes to his line-up for today’s Premier League fixture, one of them enforced by the absence of Henderson from the matchday squad to face the Red Devils. ‘He's ill,’ revealed Alonso. ‘There’s no injury, but he was not feeling well yesterday and today had a fever in the morning, so he was not feeling good enough to come with the team.’ In another of the changes, Alonso has called on Estevao, the Brazilian making his first league start of the 2026/27 season. When asked why now was the right time, our manager’s response was simple: ‘Because he's ready. ‘Because he's been preparing and training well to be ready any time, whenever he's needed, and today he's needed and we hope that he enjoys his game, and he can have a good impact.’ Estevao looks set to line up in a four-pronged Chelsea attack, alongside Pedro Neto, Cole Palmer and Morgan Rogers. However, when it comes to which of those forwards will lead the line as the central striker, Alonso is keeping his cards close to his chest. ‘It's too early to tell,’ the Spaniard said with a grin. ‘It’s too early, so we will see. It could be Morgan, but we have options.’
news.body_zh: 在斯坦福桥对阵曼联之前，哈维·阿隆索解释了为什么乔丹·亨德森没有参与其中，以及为什么现在是埃斯特沃·威廉进入首发阵容的最佳时机。我们的主教练对今天英超联赛的阵容进行了四项调整，其中一项是因为亨德森缺席对阵红魔的比赛阵容。 “他病了，”阿隆索透露。 “没有受伤，但他昨天感觉不舒服，今天早上又发烧了，所以他感觉不太好，无法随队参赛。”在另一个变化中，阿隆索给巴西人埃斯特沃打了电话，这位巴西人在2026/27赛季的联赛中首次首发。当被问及为什么现在是正确的时间时，我们的经理的回答很简单：“因为他已经准备好了。” “因为他一直在做好准备和训练，随时准备好，无论何时需要他，今天我们需要他，我们希望他享受比赛，他能产生良好的影响。”埃斯特沃看起来将与佩德罗·内托、科尔·帕尔默和摩根·罗杰斯一起参加切尔西的四管齐下的进攻。然而，当谈到哪位前锋将担任中锋时，阿隆索则守口如瓶。 “现在下结论还为时过早，”西班牙人笑着说道。 “现在还太早，所以我们拭目以待。可能是摩根，但我们有选择。

news.title: Confirmed Chelsea line up vs Manchester United
news.title_zh: 确认切尔西对阵曼联的阵容
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has opted to make four changes to his Chelsea starting XI for this afternoon's Premier League meeting with Manchester United at Stamford Bridge. We return to top-flight action after midweek Carabao Cup heartache and host a Man United side that have won just one of their eight league fixtures this term. Mike Penders continues in goal for the Blues after an impressive showing at Liverpool on Wednesday night, and is set to be protected by a back four of Josh Acheampong, Wesley Fofana, Levi Colwill and Marco Palestra, who makes his first Premier League start. Moises Caicedo captains the Blues and continues in midfield alongside Romeo Lavia. Jordan Henderson is not in the matchday squad. Estevao Willian comes into the Chelsea attack, Cole Palmer returns after serving a one-match suspension, and Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto start once again. Chelsea: Penders; Acheampong, Fofana, Colwill, Palestra; Caicedo (c), Lavia; Estevao, Palmer, Neto; Rogers Chelsea substitutes: Sharman-Lowe, Gusto, Subuloye, Chavarria, Barco, Nicoll-Jazuli, Quenda, Welbeck, Emegha
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索选择对切尔西首发阵容进行四项调整，以备战今天下午在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的英超联赛。在经历了周中卡拉宝杯的心痛之后，我们重返顶级联赛，并主场迎战一支本赛季八场联赛中只赢了一场的曼联队。迈克·彭德斯在周三晚上对阵利物浦的比赛中表现出色后，继续为蓝军守门，他将受到乔什·阿奇姆蓬、韦斯利·福法纳、列维·科尔威尔和马科·帕莱斯特拉等四名后卫的保护，后者首次在英超联赛首发。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多担任蓝军队长，并与罗密欧·拉维亚一起继续担任中场。乔丹·亨德森不在比赛日阵容中。埃斯特沃·威廉进入切尔西进攻，科尔·帕尔默在停赛一场后回归，摩根·罗杰斯和佩德罗·内托再次首发。切尔西：彭德斯； Acheampong、Fofana、Colwill、Palestra；凯塞多 (c)、拉维亚；埃斯特沃、帕尔默、内托；罗杰斯切尔西替补：沙曼-洛、古斯托、苏布洛耶、查瓦里亚、巴科、尼科尔-贾祖利、昆达、维尔贝克、埃梅加
